text: VideoAgent Product Requirements Attribute Value --- --- Document version v1.6 Updated 2026-11-04 1. Product Goal VideoAgent helps a creator act as the director: describe an idea, select a skill or production setting, generate controllable shots, review the result, and keep finished or in-progress work organized in one workspace. Every primary view is organized around a concrete creation, review, publishing, search, or asset-management task. 2. Target Users - Independent video creators. - Product and brand marketing teams. - Social media operators. - Short-drama and narrative creators. - Users who need controllable video generation across multiple model providers. 3. Navigation Desktop navigation is fixed on the left in this order: Agents Skills Videos Assets Docs The left navigation bottom shows the avatar and username trigger without a trailing chevron. Its popover spans the navigation width minus the 13px inner padding on both sides. It contains Languages, Notifications, Credits, and account actions. The current language is shown inline with a right-pointing expansion control that opens a separate right-side flyout containing English and Chinese vertically. Empty notification copy is omitted, and a green dot appears only when unread notifications exist. The avatar opens login and registration when signed out. When signed in, it shows the account email and a sign-out action. 4. Agents - The home view contains a prominent prompt composer. - The composer supports skill, hook, style, frame, duration, model, quality, audio, and review settings. - The Model selector lists every currently available video model as Provider/Model . - Character and Scene pages expose image-model selection; Shot pages expose video-model selection for both text-to-video and image-to-video. “Project default” inherits the initial choice, and changing a model invalidates the prior estimate. - When one Skill has multiple viable Provider implementations, the Agent ranks by modality, references, duration, frame, audio, language, quality, availability, and cost, then asks the user to confirm rather than silently switching providers. - The prompt editor grows downward as wrapped text or line count increases. - Idea prompts are visible only when the prompt is empty; production playbooks remain available for switching. - A user can select a Skill before starting. - Composer setting menus open above or below the trigger based on viewport space and remain inside the visible area. - Production playbooks provide one-click starting points for product ads, creator vlogs, micro drama, music videos, localization, and batch variants. - Applying a playbook fills the prompt and sets its recommended Skill, Hook, style, frame, duration, and review mode. - Selecting the active playbook again cancels it and restores the composer state that existed before the playbook was applied. - Submitting creates a project and enters the project workspace. - The VideoAgent headline and icon stream together. 5. Skills 5.1 Catalogue Skills use one flat catalogue with task-oriented cards. Official skill IDs use: <provider or product /<skill id Kling-native capabilities use the kling namespace. Cross-provider workflows and product-level Skills use video agent . Examples: video agent/search all resources kling/text to video kling/image to video kling/reference to video kling/first last frame kling/motion control kling/video extend kling/video edit video agent/style transfer video agent/video upscale video agent/product film video agent/creator vlog video agent/short drama video agent/review video agent/video localization video agent/batch variants video agent/script assistant video agent/smart preview video agent/camera movement video agent/music video video agent/reference remake video agent/agent handoff Review uses the same skill-card structure as other task-oriented Skills. 5.2 Search, Ranking, and Publishing - Skills has a top search field. - The search field stays pinned to the top while content scrolls. - Search matches user ID, skill ID, title, and description. - Category filters cover Generation, Story, Workflow, Post, Review, and Utility. - Cards show unique likes, unique account uses, and the category immediately after the title. Individual cards show neither rank nor reward. - The leaderboard score is unique uses × 2 + unique likes × 3 . - Authors cannot like their own Skill. A user contributes at most one like and one use signal to the same published Skill. - A user can publish a skill using the same publish interaction pattern used by Videos. - User-published IDs follow <user id /<skill id . 6. Videos - The top area contains a search field. - The search field stays pinned to the top while content scrolls. - Category filters cover Vlog, Product, Drama, Music, Localization, and Campaign. - Users can sort by likes or publication time while rank remains based on unique likes. - Each account contributes at most one like to a post, and authors cannot like their own post. - Cards play muted looping video. - Each card shows the title with its category immediately after it, followed by author and likes. Individual cards show neither rank nor earned credits. - Each scenario card opens Agents with its prompt and corresponding Skill. - Users can publish a post from the feed. Publishing requires an MP4 upload, title, description, and Skill. - Search matches title, author, and prompt. 7. Assets Assets contains the current user's finished and in-progress work. - The top area contains a search field. - The search field stays pinned to the top while content scrolls. - Cards are arranged as a waterfall. - Internal Video and Skill tabs separate the two asset types; cards do not repeat type labels. - Each card shows permission: private or public . - Edit time uses yyyy-mm-dd . - Duration, progress, and summary are not shown. - Video cards play a muted loop on hover and pause when hover ends. Skill cards have no cover image. - Assets displays the current user's real Videos and Skills. Every card opens a detail dialog, and video details support playback. 7.1 Project Workspace and Delivery - The resource tree has three peer groups: Directions contains editable Settings, Outlines, and Scripts; Visions contains Characters, Scenes, and Shots; Versions contains exported final video versions with their creation dates. - Settings combines production attributes and extracted Agent-director clues in one Attribute / Value table. Q&A is reduced to semantic keys and values; approval messages are not treated as attributes. - The English workspace does not render raw Chinese dialogue as Settings values. Recognized Chinese directing terms are normalized to English, while uncertain input is omitted. Long briefs are split into duration, format, product, opening, development, ending, tone, visual style, and lighting attributes instead of being stored as Creative brief or Director direction . - The approval loop fills Settings from the brief, conversation, and option choices. Once the direction is sufficient, Agents produce Outlines and Scripts and create reusable Character and Scene objects before organizing Shots. - Shot estimation and generation require at least one defined Character and one defined Scene, so every Shot is organized against reusable production objects. - Characters and Scenes own their uploaded references. Each object directory groups its images and selected reference. Scenes retain a physical location. - While Agents are planning, the conversation shows durable execution steps for context assembly, memory loading, Skill resolution, planning, validation, project-state updates, and reply composition. - The execution trace reflects completed or active work only. It must not display a Skill or MCP tool as executed when the Agent has not called it. - Final Cut provides optional publish-time visual review. Users choose a configured vision evaluator and metrics such as character consistency, style consistency, prompt alignment, and temporal stability. - Settings, Outlines, Scripts, Characters, Scenes, Shots, and version metadata remain editable or inspectable in place. - Uploads receive a stable asset ID and append @<asset-id to the active Prompt. Shots and Characters infer reference generation from that ID. - Shot, Character, and Scene results are grouped under their resource directory. Each result supports final-selection checkbox, ID copy, preview, and deletion. - Navigation, Assets, Canvas, and Agents default to equal desktop widths and provide draggable separators. - Character and shot Generation pages support an uploaded image, reference-image generation, or direct text generation where the selected model supports the mode. Generated media can be downloaded. - Uploads must pass content-type, file-signature, and size validation. - Users can inspect estimated credits and explicitly approve generation. - A final cut can be composed only after every storyboard Shot has a generated result. Deliveries support 21:9, 16:9, 9:16, and 1:1 formats. - Shot duration may extend to 30 seconds when the selected model supports it; the provider capability remains authoritative. - Final-cut composition is requested in conversation, for example “Render the final cut”; the editor does not expose a separate render button. - Export supports captions, an uploaded soundtrack, an automatic cover, and private or public permission. - Each delivery can be downloaded, shared through an expiring asset link, or published to Videos. - Project sharing creates a collaboration link with view or edit permission. An optional invited email restricts acceptance to that account. - Accepted collaborations appear in the collaborator's Projects and Recents; view-only members cannot mutate project content. - Assets lists only uploads, generated clips, deliveries, and community posts available to the current user. 8. Docs Document order: PRD Playbook Arch API Dev Test Ops FAQ TODO English labels and Chinese short labels: English Chinese --- --- PRD 产品 Playbook 策略 Arch 架构 API 接口 Dev 开发 Test 测试 Ops 运营 FAQ 客服 TODO 待办 Docs requirements: - The first document, PRD, opens by default whenever Docs is entered. - Search sits above the document body. The document directory is below search and to the left of the reader; it can collapse to an icon rail. - Its default width matches the expanded VideoAgent navigation width and can be resized independently. - A search field is available at the top. - The search field stays pinned to the top while content scrolls. - Search covers document text in both languages. - The language control changes only Docs. - The left table of contents supports navigation, highlighting, and collapse. - English and Chinese versions use the same document order. - The Docs area uses a fixed dark theme without a theme toggle. 9. Authentication and Credits - Users authenticate with email and password. - Credentials are stored only as cryptographic hashes. - Sessions use HttpOnly cookies. - The sidebar credit count reflects the current user's VideoAgent balance without exposing the shared Provider account pool. - Generation requires explicit approval before a billable provider call. - Credits are reserved before submission and refunded idempotently after submit, generation, or cancellation failures. 10. Administration - The administration route is /<locale /admin and is restricted to emails in VIDEOAGENT ADMIN EMAILS . - Overview metrics include users, projects, generation jobs, running jobs, failed jobs, and assets. - Administrators can inspect user email, project count, credits, status, and registration time. - Administrators can disable or restore accounts; disabling revokes existing sessions. - Administrators can add or remove credits with a recorded reason. - Administrators can inspect generation jobs and refund failed, cancelled, or uncertain credit holds. - Administrators can create and revoke invite codes and switch registration between open, invite-only, and closed. - Administrators can pause or resume all video generation; both estimation and submission are blocked while paused. - Administrative actions are written to an audit log. - Administrator identity is configured through the environment allowlist, not granted dynamically from the product UI. 11. Non-Functional Requirements - Desktop and mobile layouts must avoid clipped controls. - All primary controls must be keyboard accessible. - Motion supports prefers-reduced-motion . - Search and filtering run in the client. 12. Acceptance Criteria 1. Navigation order is Agents, Skills, Videos, Assets, Docs. 2. Agents can choose a Skill. 3. Skills is one searchable flat catalogue using user id/skill id . 4. Provider-native capabilities use provider namespaces; cross-provider workflows use video agent . 5. Users can publish a Skill. 6. Review appears as a normal Skill card. 7. Videos and Assets both provide top search. 8. Videos cards play video and show title above author and likes. 9. Assets uses internal Video and Skill tabs and shows permission and yyyy-mm-dd edit time. 10. Assets uses a waterfall layout; videos preview on hover and Skill cards have no cover. 11. Docs includes PRD, Playbook, Arch, API, Dev, Test, Ops, FAQ, and TODO in order. 12. Docs opens on PRD, uses a resizable left directory matching navigation width by default, and supports search plus bilingual switching. 13. Avatar provides login, registration, or sign-out based on session state. 14. Production playbooks fill the prompt and recommended production settings. 15. Videos scenario cards open Agents with the corresponding Skill selected. 16. The prompt grows with its content and empty-state suggestions disappear while typing. 17. Re-clicking the active playbook cancels selection and restores the previous draft. 18. The Model selector exposes all available video models. 19. Users can upload references, generate every shot, compose a film, download a delivery, share its content, and publish it. 20. User credit reservations, refunds, and Provider-account reconciliation agree. 21. Agents persist every recurring Character, Scene, and Shot. Character and Scene references remain attached to their object after planning revisions. 22. Reordering shots does not delete or recreate existing Shots. 23. Non-administrators cannot access administration APIs or pages. 24. Skills expose category filters, unique likes, unique uses, sorting, and a leaderboard score. 25. Videos exposes category filters, unique likes, rank, and reward projections. 26. Repeated likes toggle one account's contribution without inflating counts. 24. Administrators can manage credits, accounts, invites, and generation state, with every action recorded in the audit log.

text: VideoAgent 产品需求文档 属性 内容 --- --- 文档版本 v1.6 更新日期 2026-11-04 1. 产品目标 VideoAgent 帮助用户以导演身份完成视频创作：描述想法、选择 Skill 或制作设定、 生成可控镜头、评估结果，并在同一工作台中管理成品与半成品。 每个主页面围绕明确的选择、创建、搜索、发布、评估或资产管理任务组织。 2. 目标用户 - 独立视频创作者。 - 产品与品牌营销团队。 - 社交媒体运营人员。 - 短剧和叙事内容创作者。 - 需要跨多个模型服务进行可控视频生成的用户。 3. 导航 桌面端左侧导航顺序固定为： Agents Skills 视频 Assets Docs 左侧导航底部展示头像和账户邮箱，后方不显示下拉箭头。头像菜单左右边缘与导航栏的 13px 内边距对齐，包含语言、通知、积分和账户操作。语言行默认显示当前语言和 向右展开图标；点击后在该菜单右侧独立打开浮层，English 与中文纵向排列。没有通知时不显示空状态文案，仅在有 未读通知时显示绿点。所有表面保持半透明，桌面端菜单向上展开。 头像在未登录时提供登录和注册入口，登录后显示账户邮箱和退出操作。 4. Agents - 首页提供醒目的创作输入框。 - 创作框支持 Skill、Hook、风格、画幅、时长、模型、清晰度、音频和审核设定。 - 模型选择器展示全部当前可用的视频模型，格式为 服务商/模型 。 - Character 与 Scene 页面提供图片模型选择，Shot 页面为文生视频和图生视频提供视频模型 选择；“Project default”继承项目初始选择，切换模型会使旧积分估算失效。 - 同一 Skill 有多个可执行 Provider 时，Agent 按输入模态、参考素材、时长、画幅、音频、 语言、质量、可用性和成本排序，并要求用户确认，不静默切换服务商。 - 输入框随文字行数或自动换行向下扩展。 - 示例灵感仅在输入框为空时显示，创作策略保持可用并可切换。 - 用户可以在开始创作前选择一个 Skill。 - 创作设定的菜单根据视口剩余空间自动向上或向下展开，并始终限制在可视区域内。 - 创作场景提供产品广告、创作者 Vlog、微短剧、音乐 MV、视频本地化和批量测款的一键起点。 - 选择创作场景后，自动填入提示词，并设置推荐的 Skill、Hook、风格、画幅、时长与审核方式。 - 再次点击当前已选中的策略可取消选择，并恢复应用该策略前的创作状态。 - 提交后创建项目并进入项目工作区。 - VideoAgent 主标题和播放键图标同时参与流式输出。 5. Skills 5.1 Skill 目录 Skills 使用统一目录，并以任务型卡片组织。 官方 Skill ID 格式： <provider or product /<skill id Kling 原生能力使用 kling 命名空间；跨 Provider 工作流和产品级 Skill 使用 video agent 。 示例： video agent/search all resources kling/text to video kling/image to video kling/reference to video kling/first last frame kling/motion control kling/video extend kling/video edit video agent/style transfer video agent/video upscale video agent/product film video agent/creator vlog video agent/short drama video agent/review video agent/video localization video agent/batch variants video agent/script assistant video agent/smart preview video agent/camera movement video agent/music video video agent/reference remake video agent/agent handoff Review 使用与其他任务型 Skill 一致的卡片结构。 5.2 搜索、榜单与发布 - Skills 顶部提供搜索框。 - 搜索框在页面滚动时固定在顶部。 - 搜索范围包含 user id、skill id、标题和描述。 - 分类筛选覆盖生成、叙事、工作流、后期、评估和工具。 - 卡片展示去重点赞数、去重账户使用数，以及紧随标题的分类；卡片本身不展示排名或奖励。 - 榜单评分使用 去重使用数 × 2 + 去重点赞数 × 3 。 - 作者不能给自己的 Skill 点赞；同一账户对同一已发布 Skill 最多贡献一次点赞和 一次使用信号。 - 用户可以通过与 Videos 发布一致的方式发布 Skill。 - 用户发布 ID 使用 <user id /<skill id 格式。 6. Videos - 顶部提供搜索框。 - 搜索框在页面滚动时固定在顶部。 - 分类筛选覆盖 Vlog、产品、短剧、音乐、本地化和营销。 - 可以按点赞数或发布时间排序，排名始终按去重点赞数计算。 - 同一账户对同一作品最多贡献一次点赞，作者不能给自己的作品点赞。 - 卡片使用循环播放的视频。 - 卡片展示标题及其后的分类、作者和点赞数，不展示单卡排名或获得积分。 - 场景卡片可带着对应 Skill 和提示词进入 Agents。 - 用户可以从社区流发布作品；发布必须上传 MP4，并填写标题、描述和 Skill。 - 搜索范围包含标题、作者和 Prompt。 7. Assets Assets 展示当前用户的成品和半成品。 - 顶部提供搜索框。 - 搜索框在页面滚动时固定在顶部。 - 卡片以瀑布流排布。 - 使用 Video 和 Skill 两个内部分页区分类型，不在每张卡片上重复类型标签。 - 必须展示权限： private 或 public 。 - 编辑时间统一使用 yyyy-mm-dd 。 - 不展示时长、进度和摘要。 - Video 卡片悬浮时静音循环播放，移开后暂停并回到开始；Skill 卡片不显示封面。 - Assets 展示当前用户真实发布的 Videos 和 Skill；所有卡片可点击打开详情，视频详情可播放。 7.1 项目工作区与交付 - 资源树包含三个同级目录： Directions 管理可编辑的 Settings 、 Outlines 和 Scripts ； Visions 管理 Characters 、 Scenes 和 Shots ； Versions 管理最终视频版本及其创建日期。 - Settings 将制作属性与从 Agent-导演对话中提取的关键线索合并为 属性 / 值 表； Q&A 会提炼成语义要素和值，批准类消息不作为属性。 - 英文界面不会直接展示中文对话原文；可识别的中文创作术语会归一化为英文，无法可靠 翻译的对话不进入属性表。长 Brief 会拆成时长、形式、产品、开场、发展、结尾、基调、 视觉风格和光线等细粒度属性，而不是整体显示为 Creative brief 或 Director direction 。 - 审批循环持续从创作 Brief、对话和选项回答中填充 Settings；信息充分后生成 Outlines 和 Scripts，并创建可复用的 Character 与 Scene 对象，再组织 Shot。 - 镜头估算与生成要求至少存在一个 Character 和一个 Scene，确保分镜建立在可复用制作对象上。 - Character 与 Scene 各自承接上传和选用的参考图；Scene 保留实际地点属性。 - Agent 规划期间，对话等待区显示真实执行步骤：Context 构建、Memory 读取、 Skill 解析、规划、结构校验、项目状态更新和回复组织。 - 执行轨迹只展示已经发生或正在发生的行为，不得把未实际调用的 Skill 或 MCP 工具显示为已执行。 - Final Cut 提供可选的发布前视觉评估。用户选择已配置的视觉模型和指标，例如人物一致性、 风格一致性、提示词匹配和时序稳定性。 - Settings、Outlines、Scripts、Characters、Scenes、Shots 和版本元数据均可就地编辑或查看。 - 上传文件会获得稳定素材 ID，并自动把 @<asset-id 写入当前 Prompt； Shot 与 Character 根据该 ID 自动选择参考生成模式。 - Shot、Character 与 Scene 的上传/生成结果排列在对应资源目录下，支持最终选用勾选、 复制 ID、预览和删除。 - 桌面端导航、Assets、Canvas 和 Agents 默认等宽，并提供可拖拽分隔条。 - 角色与镜头的生成页支持上传图片、参考图生成或直接文字生成，具体模式取决于所选模型能力；生成内容可下载。 - 上传文件必须通过类型、文件头与大小校验。 - 用户可在生成前查看预计积分并明确批准生成。 - 全部 Shot 均生成后才可合成为成片，并选择 21:9、16:9、9:16、1:1 交付版本。 - 所选模型支持时，单镜头时长可扩展至 30 秒；最终以 Provider 能力为准。 - 成片由对话指令触发，例如“生成成片”；编辑区不单独展示合成按钮。 - 导出支持字幕、上传音轨、自动封面和私有/公开权限。 - 每个交付版本可下载、通过限时素材链接分享，或发布到 Videos。 - 项目分享生成可撤销的协作链接，支持查看或编辑权限；填写受邀邮箱后，仅该账号可接受。 - 被接受的协作项目会出现在协作者的 Projects 与 Recents 中；仅查看成员不能修改项目内容。 - Assets 仅展示当前用户可访问的上传、生成、导出和社区发布资产。 8. Docs 文档顺序： PRD 策略 Arch API Dev Test Ops FAQ TODO 中文缩写： 英文 中文 --- --- PRD 产品 Playbook 策略 Arch 架构 API 接口 Dev 开发 Test 测试 Ops 运营 FAQ 客服 TODO 待办 文档要求： - 每次进入 Docs 默认打开第一篇 PRD。 - 搜索框位于文档区域顶部；文档目录位于搜索框下方和阅读区左侧，默认宽度与展开状态的 VideoAgent 导航一致，可独立拖拽伸缩并可收起为图标栏。 - 顶部提供搜索框。 - 搜索框在页面滚动时固定在顶部。 - 搜索覆盖中英文文档正文。 - 语言按钮切换文档语言。 - 左侧目录支持跳转、高亮和折叠。 - 中英文版本保持相同文档顺序。 - 文档使用统一的深色阅读主题。 9. 认证与积分 - 用户通过邮箱和密码登录。 - 密码仅保存加密哈希。 - 会话使用 HttpOnly Cookie。 - 左侧导航积分来自当前用户独立的 VideoAgent 余额，不直接暴露共享 Provider 积分池。 - 任何可能计费的生成请求都必须先获得用户明确批准。 - 生成提交前预扣积分；提交失败、生成失败或取消时执行幂等退款。 10. 管理后台 - 管理入口为 /<locale /admin ，仅允许 VIDEOAGENT ADMIN EMAILS 中的邮箱访问。 - 总览展示用户、项目、生成任务、运行任务、失败任务和资产数量。 - 管理员可查看用户、项目数、积分、账号状态和注册时间。 - 管理员可停用或恢复账号；停用后现有 Session 立即失效。 - 管理员可发放或扣减用户积分，并记录操作原因。 - 管理员可查看生成任务；失败、取消和提交不确定任务支持幂等退款。 - 管理员可创建和撤销邀请码，并切换开放注册、邀请注册和关闭注册。 - 管理员可暂停或恢复全部视频生成，暂停后估算与提交均被阻断。 - 管理操作写入审计日志。 - 当前管理员身份由环境变量邮箱白名单配置，不在产品内动态授予管理员角色。 11. 非功能要求 - 桌面端和移动端不得出现控件遮挡。 - 所有核心控件应支持键盘操作。 - 动效支持 prefers-reduced-motion 。 - 搜索和筛选在客户端完成。 12. 验收标准 1. 导航顺序为 Agents、Skills、Videos、Assets、Docs。 2. Agents 可以选择 Skill。 3. Skills 使用统一的可搜索目录，并显示 user id/skill id 。 4. 原厂商能力使用厂商命名空间，跨 Provider 工作流使用 video agent 。 5. 用户可以发布 Skill。 6. Review 使用统一 Skill 卡片。 7. Videos 和 Assets 均提供顶部搜索。 8. Videos 卡片自动播放，标题位于作者与喜欢数上方。 9. Assets 通过 Video/Skill 内部分页区分类型，并展示权限和 yyyy-mm-dd 编辑时间。 10. Assets 使用瀑布流；Video 悬浮预览，Skill 卡片不显示封面。 11. Docs 依次包含 PRD、策略、Arch、API、Dev、Test、Ops、FAQ、TODO。 12. Docs 默认打开 PRD；左侧文档目录默认与导航等宽且可拖拽，搜索和双语切换可用。 13. 头像根据登录状态提供登录、注册或退出。 14. 创作策略可填充提示词和推荐制作参数。 15. Videos 场景卡片进入 Agents 时选中对应 Skill。 16. 输入框随内容向下扩展，输入内容后空态建议隐藏。 17. 重复点击已激活的策略会取消选择，并恢复应用前的草稿。 18. 模型下拉框展示全部可用视频模型。 19. 用户可上传引用素材，生成全部镜头，完成成片合成、交付下载、分享和发布。 20. 用户积分预扣、退款与 Provider 账户对账一致。 21. Agent 会持久化每个持续出现的 Character、Scene 和 Shot；规划修订后， Character 与 Scene 的引用仍保留在原对象下。 22. 调整镜头顺序不会删除或重建已有 Shot。 23. 非管理员无法访问管理接口或管理页面。 24. 管理员可管理积分、账号、邀请码和生成开关，且操作进入审计日志。 25. Skills 提供分类筛选、去重点赞、去重使用、排序和榜单评分。 26. Videos 提供分类筛选、去重点赞、排名和奖励展示。 27. 重复点赞仅切换当前账户的点赞状态，不会重复累加。

title: Playbook
text: VideoAgent Playbooks Attribute Value --- --- Document version v1.0 Updated 2026-11-04 A Playbook is a reusable production recipe. It combines a business scenario, narrative structure, default production settings, and review policy into an editable project starting point. 1. Common Structure Every Playbook includes: - Scenario name and target user - Business objective and core message - Default Skill, Hook, style, frame, duration, and review mode - Input requirements and optional references - Recommended narrative beats - Output and delivery format - Credit and model-capability constraints - Review and fallback rules 2. Product Ad For launches, proof-led creative, and performance ads. - Hook: proof first - Structure: Hook → use case → proof → hero packshot - Frame: 9:16 - Duration: 10 seconds - Skill: video agent/product film - Review: ask first 3. Creator Vlog For personal stories, lifestyle content, and brand behind-the-scenes. - Hook: visual atmosphere - Structure: context → journey → emotional turn → personal close - Frame: 9:16 - Duration: 10 seconds - Skill: video agent/creator vlog - Review: auto 4. Micro Drama For short-drama scenes, narrative ads, and social cliffhangers. - Hook: narrative twist - Structure: setup → escalation → cliffhanger or reveal - Frame: 9:16 - Duration: 10 seconds - Skill: video agent/short drama - Review: ask first 5. Music Video For music promotion, artist visuals, and rhythmic brand content. - Hook: sound cue - Structure: visual motif → performance → rhythmic escalation → return - Frame: 16:9 - Duration: 10 seconds - Skill: video agent/music video - Review: ask first 6. Localize For adapting existing footage to another market. - Preserve edit, pacing, and product facts - Adapt language, voice, subtitles, and presenter - Skill: video agent/video localization - Review: ask first 7. Batch Test For creative matrices and Hook testing. - Hold product facts and visual identity fixed - Vary Hook, scene, and expression - Produce labeled, comparable variants - Skill: video agent/batch variants - Duration: 5 seconds 8. Operations - Every Playbook references an active Skill. - Defaults stay aligned with composer fields. - Unsupported model capabilities trigger explicit adjustment or fallback. - Version changes update PRD, Arch, and Test.

title: Playbook
text: VideoAgent 策略 属性 内容 --- --- 文档版本 v1.0 更新日期 2026-11-04 策略是可复用的创作方案。它把业务场景、叙事结构、默认制作参数和审核要求 组合成一个可直接进入创作的项目起点。 1. 通用结构 每个策略包含： - 场景名称与目标用户 - 业务目标与核心信息 - 默认 Skill、Hook、风格、画幅、时长和审核模式 - 输入要求与可选参考素材 - 推荐叙事节拍 - 输出与交付形式 - 积分和模型能力约束 - 审核标准与降级策略 2. Product Ad 适用于新品发布、卖点验证和效果广告。 默认编排： - Hook：效果实证 - 结构：Hook → 使用场景 → 价值证明 → 产品主视觉 - 画幅：9:16 - 时长：10 秒 - Skill： video agent/product film - 审核：生成前确认 3. Creator Vlog 适用于个人叙事、生活方式和品牌幕后内容。 默认编排： - Hook：视觉氛围 - 结构：进入情境 → 日常推进 → 情绪转折 → 个人收束 - 画幅：9:16 - 时长：10 秒 - Skill： video agent/creator vlog - 审核：自动 4. Micro Drama 适用于短剧片段、剧情广告和社交平台悬念内容。 默认编排： - Hook：叙事反转 - 结构：建立人物 → 激化冲突 → 悬念或反转 - 画幅：9:16 - 时长：10 秒 - Skill： video agent/short drama - 审核：生成前确认 5. Music Video 适用于音乐宣发、艺人视觉和节奏型品牌内容。 默认编排： - Hook：声音开场 - 结构：视觉母题 → 表演 → 节奏升级 → 回到母题 - 画幅：16:9 - 时长：10 秒 - Skill： video agent/music video - 审核：生成前确认 6. Localize 适用于已有成片的跨市场改编。 默认编排： - 保留原剪辑、节奏和产品事实 - 适配语言、声音、字幕和人物形象 - Skill： video agent/video localization - 审核：生成前确认 7. Batch Test 适用于广告素材矩阵和 Hook 测试。 默认编排： - 固定产品事实和视觉识别 - 变化 Hook、场景和表达方式 - 生成带标签的可比较版本 - Skill： video agent/batch variants - 时长：5 秒 8. Reference Remake 适用于爆款复刻、竞品视觉拆解和跨品类迁移。 - 分析参考视频的叙事节奏、镜头顺序、动作与运镜 - 锁定可替换项：产品、人物、场景、服装和品牌信息 - 复用节奏与构图，但不复制受保护的角色、商标或独特表达 - 先产出一页镜头对照，再逐镜生成 - Skill： video agent/reference remake 9. Keyframe Story 适用于最多 30 秒的连续叙事、复杂动作与多节点转场。 - 先确定 3 至 5 个关键画面，记录人物状态、场景变化和情节节点 - 保持人物身份、空间方向、道具和光线连续 - 用运镜连接关键帧，减少无意义硬切 - 支持 21:9、16:9、9:16 与 1:1 - 文生视频参考规划；已有参考图时自动切换图生视频 - Skill： video agent/camera movement 10. Product Edit 适用于已有产品素材的二次创作与商业版本改写。 - 保留产品身份、动作连续性和核心信息 - 可替换环境、光线、天气、材质、景别与视角 - 结合图片参考锁定产品外观，结合视频参考保持动作 - 每次只改变一组明确变量，便于比较和审核 - Skill： video agent/video edit 11. 模型与能力路由 - 同一 Skill 有多个 Provider 时，先按输入模态、时长、画幅、音频、语言、质量与积分筛选。 - 多个模型都满足时，展示推荐项、 服务商/模型 、能力差异与成本，由用户确认。 - Character 与 Scene 使用图片模型选择；Shot 使用视频模型选择。 - 文生视频与图生视频都有机会在执行前覆盖项目默认模型。 - 已计费任务不会在用户不知情时静默切换 Provider。 12. 运营规则 - 策略必须引用有效 Skill。 - 默认参数必须与创作框字段一致。 - 模型能力不足时先降级或要求用户调整，不静默切换。 - 版本变化需要同步 PRD、Arch 和 Test。

text: VideoAgent Software Design Attribute Value --- --- Document version v2.0 Updated 2026-11-04 Backend framework Python + FastAPI Frontend framework Next.js + TypeScript Model Pippit/Seedance 2.5 Draft, Pippit/Seedance 2.5, Pippit/Seedance 2.0 Fast VIP, Pippit/Seedance 2.0 VIP, Pippit/Seedance 2.0 Mini Preview, Pippit/Seedance 2.0 Mini, Pippit/Wan 3.0, Pippit/HappyHorse 1.1, Kling/Kling Video 2.5, Kling/Kling Video 2.6, Kling/Kling Video O1, Kling/Kling Video 3.0, Kling/Kling Video 3.0 Omni, Kling/Kling Video 3.0 Turbo, Kling/Kling Video 4.0, Kling/Kling 2.6 Motion Control, Kling/Kling 3.0 Motion Control, Kling/Kling Image 3.0 Omni, Kling/Kling Image O1, Kling/Kling Image 3.0, Kling/Kling Image 2.1 VideoAgent integrates Pippit CLI and the China-region Kling CLI behind one provider boundary. Pippit provides video submission, task queries, and credits. Kling CLI provides text-to-video, image-to-video, motion control, and multimodal reference tools. 1. Purpose This document describes VideoAgent's product architecture, core modules, directing workflow, data model, API contracts, provider integrations, security, testing, and deployment. 2. Product Overview VideoAgent is a director-oriented AI video workspace. The public navigation contains five isolated views: - Agents: home creation composer and VideoAgent conversations. - Skills: one searchable catalogue of generation, workflow, and review skills. - Assets: a waterfall library of the user's videos and skills with permission and edit time; videos preview on hover and skills have no cover. - Videos: community feed with author, likes, playback, and publishing. - Docs: embedded bilingual documentation with a resizable document directory and a collapsible in-document table of contents. 3. Scope 3.1 Product Baseline - Left navigation with shared visual and icon behavior. - Home composer with a Skill selector, seven production settings, and custom translucent dropdowns. - Project creation, listing, reading, renaming, and archival. - User ownership isolation. - LangGraph single-node storyboard planning. - Configurable OpenAI-compatible planner with deterministic local fallback. - Storyboard replacement and versioning. - Cost estimation and explicit generation approval. - Pippit CLI text-to-video submission, task polling, and credit query. - Kling China-region CLI text-to-video, motion control, and multimodal reference capabilities. - Mock Provider and Celery polling. - Final Cut visual evaluation. - Videos feed playback, author, likes, and publishing. - English and Chinese documentation generated from paired Markdown sources. - Project-level image, video, and audio uploads with MIME, signature, and size validation. - FFmpeg composition with 16:9, 9:16, and 1:1 deliveries, covers, captions, and soundtracks. - Time-limited share links with private/public permissions, expiry, revocation, and access counts. - Per-user VideoAgent credit accounts with reservation and idempotent refunds. - An administration console for users, credits, jobs, invites, launch controls, Provider state, and audit logs. 4. Core User Flow Sign in → describe an idea in the home composer → choose style, frame, length, model, quality, audio, and review mode → create a default project → enter the project workspace → plan a storyboard with VideoAgent → estimate cost and approve generation → poll the generation job → review the storyboard → continue editing or prepare the next generation 5. Current Architecture Browser ├── Next.js product UI │ ├── shared Landing UI │ ├── embedded Docs │ └── project workspace Next.js Route Handler /api/account/ → FastAPI /api/v1 ├── Auth / Projects / Storyboards ├── Agent / Generation / Evaluation / Providers ├── Assets / Delivery / Credits ├── SQLAlchemy Async ├── LangGraph ├── FFmpeg ├── Pippit CLI └── Kling China CLI Celery Worker + Redis → Pippit / Kling task status 6. Technology Stack Area Current technology --- --- Web Next.js 16 App Router, React 19, TypeScript 5.9 UI Tailwind CSS 4, Lucide, shared Landing CSS Localization next-intl routing and translation resources Client state React page state API FastAPI, Uvicorn, Pydantic v2 Agent LangGraph, LangChain OpenAI-compatible provider Database SQLAlchemy 2 Async, SQLite Jobs Celery with Redis Video providers Pippit CLI, Kling China CLI, Mock Provider Media FFmpeg, local filesystem storage Testing pytest, Vitest, Testing Library, Playwright Quality Ruff, mypy, TypeScript 7. Agent Design The directing workflow uses an explicit LangGraph state machine: START → plan storyboard → END plan storyboard receives locale, project title, brief, current request, workflow stage/status, bounded conversation memory, current Character/Shot state, and optional Skill instructions. It returns an assistant message and a validated Character/Shot plan. The planner is: - OpenAI-compatible when VIDEOAGENT LLM API KEY and VIDEOAGENT LLM MODEL are configured. - Deterministic and local otherwise. Project, conversation, storyboard, Character, Shot, and GenerationJob state live in the database. Approval, generation, review, and polling boundaries are coordinated through FastAPI, Celery, and the workspace client. 7.1 Context and Memory - Context is bounded to the project title, brief, current request, locale, workflow state, current Character/Shot summaries, recent conversation, and optional Skill instructions. - Short-term memory uses the eight most recent historical messages, clipped to 600 characters each and excludes the current request. Storyboard context is capped at 20 Shots. - Long-term memory is the relational source of truth: Project, Conversation, Message, Workflow, Storyboard, Character, Shot, Asset, and GenerationJob. - No vector database is used yet. Project summaries and retrieval, if added, require user isolation, TTL, and deletion policy. 7.2 Skill and MCP Boundary The composer stores the selected Skill in Production settings . The Context Builder resolves an owner-owned UserSkill and attaches persisted instructions when available; built-in Skills otherwise contribute only their Skill ID. The Storyboard Agent does not hold MCP tools. MCP remains in the Provider layer so planning cannot create billable side effects. With VIDEOAGENT KLING BACKEND=mcp , the Provider Resolver constructs a StreamableHTTPToolClient using the user's OAuth token and the Kling Provider invokes text to video , image to video , or query tasks . The CLI path uses controlled subprocesses. Generation occurs only after explicit approval. 7.3 Observable Agent Run Each client-supplied run ID records context → memory → skill → planning → validation → state → reply events in agent activities . The workspace polls at 350ms and renders only actions that actually occurred; unimplemented Skill or MCP calls are never shown as executed. 8. Generation and Provider Boundary POST /shots/{id}/estimate → VideoProvider.estimate POST /shots/{id}/generate → require approved=true → require Idempotency-Key → VideoProvider.submit → persist GenerationJob → update Shot → Celery polling GET /jobs/{id} → VideoProvider.status when not terminal → update GenerationJob and Shot The VideoProvider protocol exposes estimate , submit , and status . 8.1 Pippit CLI The service runs pippit-tool-cli through argument arrays and does not use shell string interpolation. Current commands include: status get-credit-balance generate-video query-result The server owns CLI authorization. Provider billing uses the configured server account, while each product user consumes an independent VideoAgent credit balance through /credits . Access keys and CLI session files never reach the browser. 8.2 Kling China CLI Kling uses the server-owned @klingai/cli-cn package and its China-region endpoints. The CLI owns OAuth, MCP transport, and tool validation. The provider adapter maps generationId , task state, errors, and result URLs into the shared VideoProvider contract. VIDEOAGENT KLING EXPECTED USER ID verifies the authorized account. 9. Skills Catalogue Skills use one flat, searchable catalogue. Every card shows its user id/skill id identifier at the upper left. Provider-native capabilities use the provider namespace, such as kling ; cross-provider workflows and product-level Skills use video agent . Skill ID Input and result --- --- video agent/search all resources Search projects, videos, skills, Videos, and Docs kling/text to video Text prompt to one video clip kling/image to video Still image to controlled motion kling/reference to video Image, video, or audio references to a generated clip kling/first last frame Opening and closing frames to a continuous transition kling/motion control Driving-video motion applied to a subject image kling/video extend Continue an existing clip kling/video edit Prompt-directed modification of existing footage video agent/style transfer Apply a reference style while preserving structure and motion video agent/video upscale Raise video resolution up to 4K video agent/product film A composed product-video workflow video agent/creator vlog A composed creator-vlog workflow video agent/short drama A composed short-drama workflow video agent/review Score Final Cut visual consistency with a configured evaluator video agent/video localization Adapt edit, copy, voice, and presenter details for a target market video agent/batch variants Generate a controlled matrix of hooks, scenes, and messaging variants video agent/script assistant Develop premises into editable scripts with characters, beats, and hooks video agent/smart preview Prepare keyframes and an animatic before final shot generation video agent/camera movement Select and combine purposeful camera moves video agent/music video Plan performance, visual motifs, and beat-synced editing video agent/reference remake Deconstruct a reference and rebuild its structure with new footage video agent/agent handoff Package project context and assets for an external Agent via MCP or CLI Review uses the same task-oriented card structure as other Skills. Selecting a skill preloads a concrete prompt in the Agents composer. The Agents composer also includes a Skill selector. Signed-in users can publish a skill under their own <user id /<skill id namespace. Public Skills are discoverable to other signed-in users. The catalogue classifies Skills as Generation, Story, Workflow, Post, Review, or Utility. Engagement is stored as one skill engagement likes row per user and stable Skill key and one skill engagement usages row per user and key. The leaderboard score combines these de-duplicated signals as uses × 2 + likes × 3 . Videos ranks by one hots likes row per user and post. Authors cannot create engagement against their own content. The UI exposes top-three reward projections; credit settlement remains an audited operating action. The Model selector uses the verified live catalogue: seven Kling video models and eight Pippit video models, plus Auto. Options use Provider/Model naming so users can distinguish model families. The Agents composer includes production playbooks for product ads, creator vlogs, micro drama, music videos, localization, and batch variants. Selecting a playbook sets the prompt, Skill, Hook, style, frame, duration, and review mode as one coherent starting point. Playbooks use toggle behavior: selecting the active playbook again restores the pre-playbook draft. Hook controls the first-three-second strategy: visual impact, narrative twist, spoken hook, sound cue, or proof first. 10. Data Model Table Purpose --- --- users Account, password hash, and locale preference sessions Hashed server-side session tokens projects Project metadata and owner storyboards One current storyboard per project characters Ordered recurring roles, descriptions, and reusable image prompts scenes Ordered locations, environment descriptions, and reusable image prompts shots Ordered prompts, duration, frame, mode, and status conversations One conversation per project messages User and assistant messages agent activities Ordered observable events for one Agent run workspace folders Project folders for conversation organization workspace folder items Conversation-to-folder filing project workflows Concept, outline, script, and generation approval state user skills Published Skill instructions, prompt template, and I/O contracts skill engagement likes One toggleable like per user and stable Skill key skill engagement usages One de-duplicated use signal per user and stable Skill key hots posts Community video publication and metadata hots likes One toggleable like per user and Videos post generation jobs Provider task, idempotency key, status, result provider connections Provider authorization metadata oauth flows OAuth transaction state credit accounts Per-user VideoAgent balance credit entries Idempotent reservation and refund ledger assets Uploads, generated clips, deliveries, covers, and ownership share links Hashed tokens, expiry, revocation, and access count project collaborations Hashed project invite tokens, email restriction, permission, and expiry project collaborators Accepted users and their view/edit project role platform settings Generation switch and registration policy invite codes Hashed invite codes, expiry, and usage limits admin audit logs Administrative action trail 11. API Surface Base path: /api/v1 Area Endpoints --- --- Health GET /health Auth Register, login, logout, current user Projects List, create, read, rename, archive Storyboards GET and PUT /projects/{id}/storyboard Storyboard order PATCH /projects/{id}/storyboard/order Character image POST /characters/{id}/estimate , /assets , and /generate Scene references POST /scenes/{id}/assets , PATCH /projects/{id}/storyboard/scenes/{scene id} Agent Get messages, send a message, and observe a run Agent activity GET /projects/{id}/agent-activity/{run id} Workspace Folders, recent conversations, and drag-to-file conversation organization Workflow Read and decide concept, outline, and script approval stages Skills List public and owned Skills, persist drafts, and toggle likes/uses Videos Upload MP4 posts, list community videos, stream content, and toggle likes Evaluation Progress polling plus Final Cut visual-review endpoints Generation Estimate, submit, job status Providers Pippit status and credits Credits GET /credits Assets List, upload, and content download Delivery Export, asset share, publish exported video, collaboration link, accept, revoke Administration Overview, users, credits, jobs, refunds, invites, settings, and audit Agent responses and job status use regular JSON with polling. 12. Frontend Design The shared Landing UI owns: - Left navigation and responsive layout. - Continuous background carousel with no inter-frame gap. - Streaming hero title and blue play brand mark. - Custom transparent composer dropdowns. - Flat searchable Skills catalogue with categories, ranking, engagement, and user publishing. - Videos masonry feed with looping muted video playback, categories, ranking, and likes. - Searchable Assets waterfall with internal Video/Skill tabs; videos preview on hover and Skill cards omit cover images. - Searchable embedded Docs with a collapsible table of contents. - Semi-transparent search, language, notification, credit, and avatar controls. - The avatar popover aligns to the navigation rail's 13px horizontal inner padding, inherits the navigation text scale, and opens upward. Its Languages row shows the current selection with a right chevron and opens a separate right-side flyout containing English and Chinese vertically. Notifications omit empty-state copy and expose a right chevron. Account actions carry icons, while the gear sits at the right edge of the avatar row. - The muted video carousel is a persistent, translucent backdrop across Agents, Skills, Videos, Assets, Docs, and conversation views. - Viewport-aware composer menus that flip above the trigger when needed, plus upward-opening language, notification, and account menus. - Avatar account actions for login, registration, and sign-out. - An isolated /admin control room for internal operations. - Reference uploads, delivery downloads, cover preview, and share-link creation in the project workspace. - Video-shot generation stays disabled until the staged story workflow is approved, and the shot inspector shows that requirement inline. - A collapsible conversation history with Projects and Recents, plus drag-to-file organization. Both groups are visible before sign-in and when empty. - Project folders expose the disclosure control before a blue folder icon. Filed conversations move out of Recents and render as indented children of their project folder. - An IDE-style three-part canvas: Directions , Visions , and Versions resources, the selected editor document or asset, and the approval-driven Agents panel. - The Assets and Agents side panels can collapse to labeled rails. Their widths use responsive clamped proportions so they remain usable across desktop sizes. - Directions contains editable Settings , Outlines , and Scripts . Visions contains Characters , Scenes , and Shots . Versions is a peer top-level directory for exported final video versions. Characters and Scenes own their uploaded references; each Shot opens one combined page. Empty directories render no waiting copy. - Skill Studio persists reusable Skills with a stable namespace, instructions, quality gates, prompt template, and input/output contracts. AI optimize turns an early idea into that structure. - The built-in video agent/skill synthesis Skill opens Skill Studio directly to help authors compose new Skills. - The app navigation collapses from a control beside the VideoAgent brand into an icon-only left rail while the remaining content fills the space. Projects and chronological Recents live below the Docs divider, are expanded by default, and remain collapsible. - Conversations use only the /en conversation/{project id} hash view, preserve the mounted application shell, and highlight the matching history item. - The Projects row opens the project creation form, while the Recents row starts a new Agents conversation. Both rows provide disclosure controls. - Videos publishing requires an MP4 upload and persists the video as a public asset. The author's Assets view lists real Videos and Skills, and every card opens a detail dialog. - The editor pane header is always titled Storyboard with a clapperboard icon; it does not change with the selected resource. Share stays aligned at its far right. - Final Cut review is separate from readiness. Users choose a configured vision evaluator and metrics for character consistency, style consistency, prompt alignment, or temporal stability. - Settings derives semantic attributes from conversation instead of showing raw Q&A or approval decisions as values. - Attribute extraction excludes language-correction meta instructions and derives duration, format, product, opening, development, ending, tone, visual style, and lighting separately. Recognized Chinese terms are normalized to English; uncertain translations are omitted from the English attribute table. - Shot and Character editors expose editable descriptions and prompts. Uploads append @<asset-id to the prompt and the server infers reference mode. - Results live under their Shot or Character directory with persisted final selection, copy-ID, preview, and delete actions. - Desktop navigation, Assets, Canvas, and Agents use equal defaults and draggable pane separators. Account essentials live in the profile popover. - Only a newly returned Agent reply uses type-on presentation. Persisted history and completed replies render as static text, including after a panel is collapsed and reopened. - Docs occupies the full content area beside the navigation rail without overlapping it; its embedded document uses the same persistent backdrop. - Docs opens on the first document. Its vertical document directory defaults to the expanded navigation width and can be resized independently with a draggable separator. Search is above the directory, which can also collapse to an icon rail. - Workspace text never renders smaller than button text, and authentication pages use the same dark visual system as the product. - Active navigation and asset icons invert outline and fill: inactive icons are transparent inside with a blue stroke; active icons are blue-filled with a transparent stroke. - Navigation, project folders, and conversation items share one type scale. Projects, Recents, and conversation items are text-only; dates, counts, and empty-state copy are not rendered. - History lists use a thin blue scrollbar with a transparent track. - Assets, editor, and Agents scrolling surfaces use the same thin blue scrollbar treatment as Projects and Recents. The project workspace progresses through overall direction, episode and shot outline, scene script, and generation-ready states. Each transition requires an explicit user decision. Refinement and custom instructions remain on the current stage. 13. Documentation Language - The Languages row inside the avatar popover controls documentation language. - English documents are generated as .html . - Chinese documents are generated as .zh.html . - Document tabs are PRD , Playbook , Arch , API , Dev , Test , Ops , FAQ , and TODO . 14. Security and Reliability - Session cookies are HttpOnly and SameSite=Lax. - Cross-user resources return 404 . - Provider commands use argument arrays and timeouts. - Generation submissions use database idempotency keys. - The database is the source of truth for project, shot, and job state. - Same-origin validation protects cookie-authenticated writes. - Auth, generation, and upload requests use separate rate-limit buckets. - Uploaded media is validated by declared MIME, signature, and size. - Share tokens are stored as hashes and support expiry, revocation, and access accounting. - Collaboration tokens are separate from media-share tokens. Accepting a valid token creates a project membership with view or edit permission; email restrictions are checked against the authenticated account. - Administrative APIs require an email in VIDEOAGENT ADMIN EMAILS . - Disabling an account revokes its existing sessions. - Generation checks the runtime kill switch before estimation and submission. 15. Deployment Local development: Next.js :3000 FastAPI :8000 SQLite Pippit CLI or Kling China CLI Celery + Redis 16. Acceptance Baseline 1. Users can create, rename, and archive their own projects. 2. VideoAgent creates a validated multi-shot storyboard. 3. Cost and approval are visible before generation. 4. Jobs and storyboards survive a page refresh or API restart. 5. Provider credentials never reach the browser. 6. Readiness polls the workflow and completed Shots; visual review runs only on Final Cut. 7. Skills is a flat searchable catalogue using user id/skill id , with workflows and Review presented as normal skill cards. 8. Documentation switches between English and Chinese and follows the complete nine-document order. 9. Production playbooks and Skill-backed Videos scenarios provide editable, reusable starting points. 10. The prompt editor grows with stacked or wrapped content, and empty-state suggestions hide as soon as non-whitespace input exists. 11. Playwright uses the Mock Provider to complete registration, creation, upload, generation, export, download, and sharing without paid credits. 12. User credits are reserved before submission and refunded idempotently when submission, generation, or cancellation ends without a usable result. 13. Administrators can manage accounts, credits, invites, and generation state, with every mutation recorded in the audit log.

O1、Kling/Kling Image 3.0、Kling/Kling Image 2.1 VideoAgent 通过统一 Provider 边界集成 Pippit CLI 与 Kling 国内版 CLI。Pippit 提供视频提交、任务查询和积分能力，Kling CLI 通过国内站 MCP 提供文本生成视频、任务查询、动作控制和多模态参考能力。 1. 文档目的 本文档描述 VideoAgent 的产品目标、系统架构、核心模块、Agent 编排、数据模型、接口规范、Pippit CLI 与 Kling 国内版 CLI 集成、安全策略、测试策略及部署方式，供产品、前端、后端、测试和运维研发人员共同参考。 2. 产品概述 VideoAgent 是一个面向内容创作者、营销人员和普通用户的 AI 视频创作平台。产品以“用户是导演”为核心，通过统一的左侧工作台进入 Agents、Skills、Videos、Assets 和 Docs；用户从首页创作框描述创意后创建项目，进入项目工作区与 VideoAgent 协作生成故事板并发起镜头生成。 系统同时提供： - Agents： 首页创作入口和项目内 VideoAgent 对话。 - Skills： 单一可搜索 Skill 目录，使用 user id/skill id 标识，并支持用户发布。 - Videos： 可搜索社区作品流，展示作者、喜欢数并支持发布。 - Assets： 用户成品与半成品作品库，按 Video/Skill 分页；视频悬浮预览，Skill 不显示封面。 - Docs： 九份中英文文档、全文搜索、统一深色阅读主题、默认与导航等宽且可伸缩的文档目录，以及文档内可折叠章节目录。 创作范式结合对话式生成、模板化制作和多模型工作台组织方式。生成能力通过统一 Provider 契约接入，使项目、故事板、镜头和任务状态不依赖单一模型服务。 3. 产品目标与范围 3.1 MVP 目标 - 首页采用左侧导航、连续视频背景、居中创作框、场景策略、Hook 控制和自定义透明下拉控件。 - 创作输入框随内容行数自动向下增高；示例灵感仅在输入为空时显示，策略保持可切换。 - 模型选择器使用实时核验目录：Kling 7 个视频模型、Pippit 8 个视频模型，另有 Auto；选项统一使用 服务商/模型 格式。 - 搜索、语言、通知、积分和头像使用半透明表面；头像菜单左右边缘对齐导航栏的 13px 内边距，并沿用导航字号。菜单包含语言、通知、积分与带图标的账户操作，通知行带向右展开图标，齿轮位于头像行右端；语言行使用向右图标，点击后在头像菜单右侧独立打开浮层并纵向排列 English 与中文。 - Videos 展示作者与喜欢数，并支持发布。 - 支持项目创建、编辑、恢复和删除。 - 支持 Agent 生成创意方案和多镜头故事板。 - 支持镜头参数编辑和积分成本估算。 - 支持 Final Cut 发布前的视觉模型评估。 - 支持项目级图片、视频和音频素材上传，并校验 MIME、文件头和大小。 - 支持 FFmpeg 合成、16:9/9:16/1:1 交付版本、封面、字幕和音轨。 - 支持限时分享链接、公开/私有权限、过期和撤销。 - 支持用户独立积分账户与预扣、退款流水，隔离共享 Provider 账户的计费风险。 - 支持管理员控制台、用户状态、积分调整、邀请码、生成开关和审计日志。 - 支持服务端统一授权的 Pippit CLI。 - 支持 Pippit 文本生成视频、任务查询和积分余额读取。 - 支持 Kling 国内版 CLI 的文本生成视频、任务查询、动作控制和多模态参考能力。 - 支持 Celery 后台轮询与前端任务状态轮询。 - 保证 Provider Access Key、CLI 登录文件和 MCP 凭据不暴露给浏览器。 4. 用户与核心场景 4.1 目标用户 - 普通内容创作者。 - 电商和产品营销人员。 - 社交媒体运营人员。 - 广告创意和短视频制作人员。 4.2 核心用户流程 登录 → 在首页多设定创作框描述创意 → 提交时自动创建默认项目 → 直接进入项目工作区 → Agent 追问并生成创意方案 → 编辑故事板和镜头 → 查看预计积分 → 确认生成 → 查看生成进度 → 审核并重新生成镜头 → 继续编辑或准备下一轮生成 5. 总体架构 5.1 实现架构 ┌─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────┐ │ Next.js App │ │ 共享 Landing UI / 项目工作区 / 内嵌文档 │ Agent 设计 9.1 基本策略 Agent 使用一个主 Agent 和一个确定性节点，不采用无限制 ReAct 循环，也不将相互耦合的创作职责拆成多个自由对话 Agent。 - LangGraph 负责故事板规划。 - 配置 LLM 时由 LangChain OpenAI-compatible Provider 执行模型调用；未配置时使用本地确定性规划器。 - Pydantic 校验模型输出和工具参数。 - Celery 执行 Provider 任务轮询。 - 项目、对话、故事板和生成任务保存到关系数据库。 Agent 图： START → plan storyboard → END plan storyboard 接收项目标题、Brief、用户消息、Locale、工作流阶段与状态， 输出 assistant message 和经 Pydantic 校验的 Character/Shot 计划，并同步持久化消息和故事板。 9.2 Context 与 Memory - Context 是单次规划调用的有界输入：项目标题、Brief、当前用户请求、Locale、 工作流阶段/状态、当前 Character/Shot 摘要、最近对话和可选 Skill 指令。 - 短期 Memory 从关系数据库读取最近 8 条历史消息，每条最多保留 600 字符； 当前请求不重复放入历史。故事板上下文最多读取前 20 个 Shot。 - 长期 Memory 是数据库事实：Project、Conversation/Message、ProjectWorkflow、 Storyboard、Character、Shot、Asset 和 GenerationJob。任何写操作都以数据库为唯一事实来源。 - 当前不引入向量数据库，也不把 Provider 原始上下文写入 Prompt。后续可增加 项目摘要与向量检索，但必须有 TTL、用户隔离和删除策略。 9.3 Skill 调用 Composer 选择的 Skill 先写入项目 Brief 的 Production settings 。规划前， Context Builder 解析 Skill ID；如果当前用户发布过同名 UserSkill，则加载其 instructions 和 starter prompt 并加入规划 Context。内置 Skill 没有数据库指令时， 只把 Skill ID 作为创作约束传入。 Skill 不是 HTTP 工具调用，也不会在规划阶段直接生成视频。计费 Provider 只在用户 明确批准后，由 Generation API 调用。 9.4 MCP 调用边界 Storyboard Agent 当前不直接持有 MCP 工具，避免模型在规划阶段自行产生付费副作用。 Kling MCP 位于 Provider 层：选择 Kling 且 VIDEOAGENT KLING BACKEND=mcp 时， Provider Resolver 使用当前用户的 OAuth Token 创建 StreamableHTTPToolClient ； KlingVideoProvider 再调用 text to video 、 image to video 或 query tasks 。 默认国内版 CLI 路径由受控子进程完成同类调用。角色图片当前通过 Kling CLI 的文生图/ 参考图生图执行。 9.5 Agent 行为可观测性 每次 Agent run 使用客户端提供的 run id 记录： context → memory → skill → planning → validation → state → reply 事件写入 agent activities 表，前端以 350ms 间隔轮询该 run 的事件，并在 Agents 等待区显示实时步骤。事件只描述真实发生的上下文装载、规划、校验和 状态写入，不把未调用的 MCP 或 Skill 工具显示为已执行。 10. 图片、视频和音频引用素材上传。 - 成片导出、交付版本下载、封面与分享链接。 15.3 前端状态 - 页面使用 React useState 、 useEffect 、页面级 fetch 和定时轮询。 - Agent 消息使用普通 JSON 请求；流式输出使用前端分段动画呈现。 - 项目事件使用轮询。 - 不将 Provider 凭据、Access Key 或敏感任务内容写入 localStorage。 - 私有媒体通过受鉴权的内容路由读取，分享内容通过随机 Token 读取。 16. 国际化策略 产品使用 next-intl 路由、消息资源和后端 locale 字段管理 en 与 zh-CN 。文档提供两套同构内容。 Agent 输出支持三种 Prompt 模式： - 中文说明 + 英文模型 Prompt。 - 全中文。 - 中英双语对照。 后端 API 使用稳定错误码；用户可读文案由前端翻译资源提供。用户语言偏好 仍可通过 PATCH /auth/me 保存。 17. 安全与隐私 - 所有项目、镜头和任务接口均校验用户所有权。 - 会话 Cookie 使用 HttpOnly 与 SameSite=Lax；生产环境必须启用 Secure。 - Pippit CLI 登录文件放在服务账号可访问但受严格权限保护的位置。 - VIDEOAGENT PIPPIT ACCESS KEY 只保存在秘密管理系统或服务环境变量中。 - 不使用 Agent 生成的内容拼接 Shell 命令。 - 日志不记录密码、Cookie、Token、Authorization Header。 - Cookie 写接口校验 Origin 与 Sec-Fetch-Site ，拒绝跨站提交。 - 认证、生成和上传分别执行分钟级限流；分布式部署需将计数迁移到 Redis。 - 上传同时校验声明的 MIME、文件签名和大小。 - 分享链接只保存 Token 哈希，并支持过期、撤销和访问计数。 - 项目协作邀请与素材分享使用独立 Token；接受邀请后写入 ProjectCollaborator， 服务端按 view/edit 权限限制读取和修改，邮箱邀请同时校验当前登录邮箱。 - 管理接口使用环境变量邮箱白名单授权，普通用户访问返回 403 。 - 停用账号会立即删除其全部 Session。 - 生成开关在 Provider 估算和提交前检查，暂停时不产生外部费用。 18. 可靠性设计 - 数据库任务状态为业务事实来源。 - Celery 负责 Provider 轮询，并对未结束任务按配置重试。 - 生成提交使用数据库幂等键；查询失败可以重试，计费提交禁止盲目重发。 - 前端轮询 GET /jobs/{id} ，数据库是状态事实来源。 - Provider 子进程有超时，超时后终止且不自动重提。 19. 可观测性 后端使用 structlog 记录请求与任务日志。核心字段包括 request id 、 user id 、 project id 、 job id 、 provider 、 duration ms 和 error code 。 20. 测试策略 测试以测试驱动开发为主要工作方式。详细测试范围、测试用例、覆盖目标和质量门禁见 docs/software-test-plan.md 。 整体原则： - 每个业务能力先编写失败测试，再实现最小代码，最后重构。 - CI 仅使用 Mock Provider，不执行真实付费生成。 - 单元测试不依赖 PostgreSQL、Redis、MinIO 或 Pippit 网络。 - 集成测试使用可重复、可清理的真实基础设施。 - Pippit 状态和余额只读 Smoke Test 使用受控服务账户。 - 真实生成测试必须人工触发并显式限制次数和积分预算。 21. 配置项 后端使用 VIDEOAGENT 前缀的环境变量： VIDEOAGENT DATABASE URL VIDEOAGENT SESSION SECRET VIDEOAGENT TOKEN ENCRYPTION KEY VIDEOAGENT VIDEO PROVIDER VIDEOAGENT PIPPIT CLI COMMAND VIDEOAGENT PIPPIT ACCESS KEY VIDEOAGENT PIPPIT VIDEO MODEL VIDEOAGENT PIPPIT VIDEO RESOLUTION VIDEOAGENT CELERY ENABLED VIDEOAGENT CELERY BROKER URL VIDEOAGENT CELERY RESULT BACKEND VIDEOAGENT LLM BASE URL VIDEOAGENT LLM API KEY VIDEOAGENT LLM MODEL VIDEOAGENT MEDIA DIR VIDEOAGENT MAX UPLOAD BYTES VIDEOAGENT FFMPEG COMMAND VIDEOAGENT FFPROBE COMMAND VIDEOAGENT STARTING USER CREDITS VIDEOAGENT AUTH RATE LIMIT PER MINUTE VIDEOAGENT GENERATION RATE LIMIT PER MINUTE VIDEOAGENT UPLOAD RATE LIMIT PER MINUTE NEXT PUBLIC API BASE URL 所有敏感值通过环境变量或密钥管理服务提供，不提交到 Git。 22. 部署设计 本地开发： Next.js :3000 FastAPI :8000 SQLite（默认） Pippit CLI 或 Kling 国内版 CLI Celery + Redis Markdown 文档在构建时生成 HTML，并复制到 public/docs 。 部署流程： 1. 安装锁定依赖。 2. 执行 Ruff、mypy 和测试。 3. 构建前后端镜像。 4. 执行版本化数据库迁移。 5. 滚动更新 API。 6. 更新 Worker。 7. 检查健康和 Provider 状态。 23. 验收标准 1. 用户能够创建、修改、归档和删除自己的项目。 2. Agent 能生成符合 Pydantic Schema 的多镜头故事板。 3. 用户可以在生成前查看并批准预计积分费用。 4. 刷新页面或重启服务后故事板和任务状态不会丢失。 5. Pippit Access Key、CLI 登录文件和 Kling 凭据不出现在浏览器、日志或公开接口中。 6. 生成任务不会因自动重试造成重复扣费。 7. 制作进度条根据工作流和 Shot 完成状态实时轮询；视觉评估只作用于 Final Cut。 8. Videos 的作者、喜欢数、发布入口和预览可用。 9. Mock Provider、Pippit Fake CLI 和 Kling Provider 契约测试全部通过。 10. Playwright 使用 Mock Provider 完成注册、创作、上传、生成、导出、下载和分享。 11. 生成预扣积分，失败或取消时幂等退款。 12. 分享链接可撤销，私有资产不能由其他用户通过内容路由读取。 13. 管理员可管理账号、积分、邀请码和生成状态，所有变更写入审计日志。 24. 主要风险 风险 应对措施 --- --- Pippit CLI 参数或输出变化 命令契约测试、Provider 隔离、版本锁定 生成提交超时导致不确定状态 本地幂等键、任务对账、禁止盲目重试 视频生成耗时长 Celery、持久任务、超时与状态查询 费用误用 审批门、预算上限、积分流水 Token 泄露 服务端加密、日志脱敏、Cookie 安全 前后端类型不一致 OpenAPI 契约测试 Celery 与 LangGraph 状态重复 明确数据库事实来源和单向事件流 中英文内容不同步 统一翻译键、双语测试、Agent Locale 状态

title: API
text: VideoAgent API Reference Attribute Value --- --- Document version v1.5 Updated 2026-11-04 Base path /api/v1 Authentication HttpOnly Session Cookie Request format JSON with credentials: "include" API style REST with job polling Billable generation Explicit approval plus Idempotency-Key Write protection Same-origin Origin / Sec-Fetch-Site validation User credits Internal per-user quota with an auditable ledger Administration VIDEOAGENT ADMIN EMAILS allowlist OpenAPI /docs and /openapi.json Base URL: http://localhost:8000/api/v1 Interactive OpenAPI documentation is available at: http://localhost:8000/docs http://localhost:8000/openapi.json All endpoints require authentication except /health , /auth/register , /auth/login , /auth/registration-policy , and /shares/{token}/content . Browser clients must send the session cookie for authenticated endpoints. Authentication The API uses an HttpOnly session cookie named videoagent session . Browser clients must send requests with credentials enabled. Register POST /auth/register { "email": "creator@example.com", "password": "at-least-eight-characters", "locale": "zh-CN", "invite code": "optional-invite-code" } Registration Policy GET /auth/registration-policy Returns open , invite , or closed . Invite mode requires invite code . Login POST /auth/login { "email": "creator@example.com", "password": "at-least-eight-characters" } Current User GET /auth/me Returns the authenticated user's ID, email, locale, and creation time. Update Locale PATCH /auth/me { "locale": "en" } Logout POST /auth/logout Revokes the current session and removes the session cookie. Health GET /health Returns API status and database dependency health. A database failure returns 503 with status: "degraded" . Projects All project endpoints require authentication and are scoped to the current user. Another user's project returns 404 . Method Path Purpose --- --- --- GET /projects List active projects POST /projects Create a project GET /projects/{project id} Read a project PATCH /projects/{project id} Rename a project DELETE /projects/{project id} Archive a project GET /workspace List project folders and all recent conversations POST /workspace/folders Create a project folder PATCH /workspace/folders/{folder id} Rename a project folder DELETE /workspace/folders/{folder id} Delete a folder without deleting conversations PUT /workspace/threads/{project id}/folder File or unfile a conversation Create request: { "title": "Launch film", "brief": "A ten-second cinematic product launch" } Rename request: { "title": "Launch film — final" } Storyboards Read Storyboard GET /projects/{project id}/storyboard Replace Storyboard PUT /projects/{project id}/storyboard { "characters": [ { "name": "Mara", "description": "A reserved photographer in her early thirties.", "prompt en": "Editorial portrait with stable identity and natural skin texture", "prompt zh": "稳定身份与自然肤质的角色定妆照" } ], "scenes": [ { "name": "Studio", "location": "Downtown loft", "description": "A warm production loft with large windows.", "prompt en": "Cinematic production loft with warm daylight", "prompt zh": "暖日光下的电影感制作空间" } ], "shots": [ { "description": "Opening product reveal", "prompt en": "Cinematic product reveal with warm rim light", "prompt zh": "暖色轮廓光下的电影感产品亮相", "duration seconds": 5, "aspect ratio": "16:9", "generation mode": "text to video" } ] } Reorder Storyboard PATCH /projects/{project id}/storyboard/order The request must contain every current Shot exactly once. Reordering preserves Shot IDs, generated assets, generation history, and project continuity. { "shot ids": [ "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002", "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001" ] } VideoAgent Conversation List Messages GET /projects/{project id}/messages Send Message POST /projects/{project id}/messages { "content": "Turn the brief into a three-shot launch film", "run id": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000020" } The response includes the user message, VideoAgent reply, and updated storyboard as JSON. The response also includes the current approval stage. Observe Agent Activity GET /projects/{project id}/agent-activity/{run id} Returns ordered activity events for the run: { "items": [ { "id": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000021", "run id": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000020", "sequence": 1, "kind": "context", "label": "Assembled working context", "detail": "locale=en · workflow=concept/awaiting approval", "status": "completed", "created at": "2026-11-05T08:00:00Z" } ] } Activity kinds are context , memory , skill , planning , validation , state , and reply . The workspace polls this endpoint while waiting so the trace reflects actual execution rather than decorative animation. Read Workflow GET /projects/{project id}/workflow The workflow progresses through concept , outline , script , and ready . concept establishes the creative direction, outline defines episodes and shots, and script develops the scene-level production text. Generation is only enabled after the script is approved and the state becomes ready . Submit Workflow Decision POST /projects/{project id}/workflow/decision { "choice": "approve", "instruction": null, "run id": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000020" } choice is approve , refine , or custom . Refinements preserve the current stage. An approval advances one stage and creates the next refinement level. Generation Estimate Cost POST /shots/{shot id}/estimate Generate Shot POST /shots/{shot id}/generate Required header: Idempotency-Key: unique-request-id Request: { "approved": true, "generation mode": "image to video", "reference asset id": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000010", "provider": "kling", "model": "kling-video-v4 0" } generation mode is text to video or image to video . Image-to-video requires a project-owned image asset that belongs to the current user. Estimation and generation return 409 VISION OBJECTS REQUIRED until the storyboard contains at least one Character and one Scene. provider and model are optional per-task overrides. Omit both to use the project default. Changing the override invalidates the previous estimate. Character Image Generation Method Path Purpose --- --- --- POST /characters/{character id}/estimate Estimate character image credits POST /characters/{character id}/assets Upload a character image POST /characters/{character id}/generate Generate or edit a character image Generation request: { "approved": true, "generation mode": "image to image", "reference asset id": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000010", "provider": "kling", "model": "kling-image-v3 0" } generation mode is text to image or image to image . A successful request returns an AssetRead whose content can be previewed and downloaded through content url . Scene Editing and References PATCH /projects/{project id}/storyboard/scenes/{scene id} updates name, location, description, or prompts. POST /scenes/{scene id}/assets uploads a scene reference image. The returned asset filename is namespaced to the scene so the workspace can keep it under that Scene directory. Job Status GET /jobs/{job id} Possible statuses include submitted , queued , running , succeeded , failed , and cancelled . Each successful generation reserves the estimated credits from the current user's VideoAgent balance. An immediate submission failure or a later failed or cancelled job returns the reservation through an idempotent refund entry. Credits GET /credits Returns the authenticated user's internal VideoAgent quota. This balance is separate from the server-owned Provider account pool. { "provider": "video agent", "connected": true, "credits": 95 } Skills Method Path Purpose --- --- --- GET /skills List public Skills and Skills owned by the current user POST /skills Persist a structured Skill POST /skills/optimize Convert a rough capability idea into a structured draft POST /skills/engagement/query Read signals for up to 100 stable Skill keys POST /skills/engagement/like Toggle a like for a stable Skill key POST /skills/engagement/use Record one de-duplicated use signal The optimizer returns a stable skill id , title, description, detailed instructions, starter prompt, and input/output JSON schemas. List responses add is mine , likes , uses , and is liked . Engagement endpoints accept {"skill key":"<user id /<skill id "} , which allows bundled and published Skills to share one persistent signal store. Authors cannot like their own Skill; repeated requests from the same account do not inflate either counter. { "skill key": "video agent/creator vlog" } POST /skills/engagement/query accepts {"skill keys":["<user id /<skill id "]} and returns a keyed items object. This lets the client hydrate engagement for built-in Skills that are not rows in the user Skill table. { "idea": "Turn product stills into premium campaign videos", "title": "Editorial product film", "locale": "en" } Videos Method Path Purpose --- --- --- GET /hots List published community videos; mine=true filters to the current user POST /hots Upload an MP4 and publish a community post POST /hots/{post id}/like Toggle the current user's like GET /hots/{post id}/video Stream the public video POST /hots uses multipart/form-data with file , title , prompt , and skill . The uploaded video asset is public and appears in the authenticated author's Assets view. Videos responses include is liked ; one account contributes at most one like, and authors cannot like their own post. Production Progress GET /projects/{project id}/progress Returns the live production percentage used by the workspace progress bar. It tracks the workflow stage and completed Shots; it is readiness, not a visual quality score. Final Cut Visual Review GET /projects/{project id}/visual-review/models Returns the configured visual evaluator models. POST /projects/{project id}/visual-review { "asset id": "00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000030", "model": "vision-model", "metrics": [ "character consistency", "style consistency", "prompt alignment", "temporal stability" ] } The endpoint accepts only an exported Final Cut asset, extracts representative frames, and sends them to the selected configured vision model. It returns paper-style or trained-model consistency metrics with evidence. When no evaluator is configured, the API returns 503 VISUAL REVIEW UNAVAILABLE instead of fabricating scores. Assets and Media Media endpoints are scoped to the authenticated user. Unsupported content types, invalid file signatures, and files above the configured size limit are rejected before an Asset record is created. Method Path Purpose --- --- --- GET /assets List the current user's assets GET /projects/{project id}/assets List assets for one owned project POST /projects/{project id}/assets Upload image, video, or audio media PATCH /assets/{asset id} Rename an owned asset DELETE /assets/{asset id} Soft-delete an owned asset GET/PUT /projects/{project id}/asset-selections Read or update final asset choices GET /assets/{asset id}/content Download or preview a private asset POST /projects/{project id}/exports Compose and export the current film POST /assets/{asset id}/share Create a time-limited share link POST /hots/from-asset/{asset id} Publish an existing exported final cut POST /projects/{project id}/collaborations Create a project collaboration link POST /collaborations/{token}/accept Accept an invite and join the project DELETE /shares/{share id} Revoke a share link GET /shares/{token}/content Read a valid shared asset without a session Upload request: POST /projects/{project id}/assets Content-Type: multipart/form-data file=<image, video, or audio Project uploads accept an optional shot id form field. The returned asset UUID is the stable ID used in prompts as @<asset-id . Export request: { "aspect ratios": ["16:9", "9:16", "1:1"], "soundtrack asset id": null, "captions": "A generated product story", "permission": "private" } The export response contains delivery Assets and a generated cover. Export requires every storyboard Shot to have a generated result. The current implementation composes those generated shots with FFmpeg, normalizes each delivery ratio, applies a short crossfade between shots, and optionally includes captions and an uploaded soundtrack. Share request: { "expires in hours": 24 } Share tokens are random, stored as hashes, expire after the requested period, and can be revoked. Access increments an audit counter. Collaboration request: { "permission": "edit", "collaborator email": "editor@example.com", "expires in hours": 168 } Collaboration links are distinct from asset-share links. They grant project membership after authenticated acceptance and enforce view or edit permission on project endpoints. Administration Administration endpoints require an authenticated account whose email appears in VIDEOAGENT ADMIN EMAILS . Other users receive 403 ADMIN ACCESS REQUIRED . Method Path Purpose --- --- --- GET /admin/me Confirm administration access GET /admin/overview Counts and launch-state summary GET /admin/users Search users and read credits PATCH /admin/users/{id} Enable or disable an account POST /admin/users/{id}/credits Add or remove credits GET /admin/jobs Inspect generation jobs POST /admin/jobs/{id}/refund Refund a failed or uncertain hold GET/PATCH /admin/settings Read or update generation and registration GET/POST /admin/invites List or create invite codes DELETE /admin/invites/{id} Revoke an invite code GET /admin/audit Read administrative audit entries GET /admin/provider Read the active Provider connection state Settings update: { "generation enabled": false, "registration mode": "invite" } When generation is disabled, estimate and submit endpoints return 503 GENERATION DISABLED . Disabling an account revokes its Sessions immediately. Pippit Provider Method Path Purpose --- --- --- GET /providers/pippit Read server-owned Pippit account status GET /providers/pippit/credits Read the active Pippit credit balance Pippit authorization is server-owned. The API invokes the installed pippit-tool-cli binary; browser clients never receive access keys or CLI session files. Provider billing draws from the configured server account, while product users consume independent VideoAgent balances through /credits . Operators authorize the CLI on the API host before enabling live generation. GET /providers/pippit response: { "provider": "pippit", "connected": true, "scope": "server" } GET /providers/pippit/credits response: { "provider": "pippit", "connected": true, "credits": 42 } If the server CLI is not logged in, the credits endpoint returns connected: false and credits: null . A missing binary returns 503 ; an upstream CLI failure returns 502 . Kling Provider VideoAgent uses the server-owned China-region @klingai/cli-cn package and the https://klingai.com/mcp endpoint. Kling tokens never reach the browser. VIDEOAGENT KLING EXPECTED USER ID pins the authorized domestic account. Operators can use kling who am i and kling account for read-only identity and credit checks. Errors Errors use the following shape: { "error": { "code": "PROJECT NOT FOUND", "message": "The project was not found.", "details": {}, "requestId": "request-id" } } Important status codes: Status Meaning --- --- 401 Authentication required or session expired 402 The user's VideoAgent credit balance is insufficient 403 Approval, administrator, registration, or invite policy denied 404 Resource not found or not owned by the current user 409 Configured provider is not active 413 Uploaded media exceeds the configured limit 422 Request validation failed 429 An auth, generation, or upload rate limit was exceeded 502 Upstream provider request failed 503 Provider CLI is unavailable or generation is paused
