Purpose This guide describes the VideoAgent implementation architecture, module boundaries, runtime flow, provider adapters, and engineering conventions. 2. System Scope - Next.js App Router product UI. - Left navigation: Agents, Skills, Videos, Assets, Docs. - Home composer with Skill and Hook selectors, six production playbooks, and transparent custom dropdowns. - Auto-growing prompt textarea with idea suggestions rendered only in the empty state. - Complete live video-model catalogue with provider-labelled Pippit and Kling options. - Flat searchable Skills catalogue using user id/skill id , plus user publishing. - Searchable Videos feed with looping video playback, Skill-backed scenario reuse, and publishing. - Searchable Assets waterfall with internal Video/Skill tabs, permission, and yyyy-mm-dd edit date; videos preview on hover, Skill cards have no cover, and cards do not repeat type labels. - Searchable bilingual Docs with nine documents, a collapsible table of contents, and full-text lookup across languages. - Registration, login, logout, server-side sessions, and user isolation. - Project create, list, read, rename, and archive. - Storyboard read and whole-document replacement. - LangGraph single-node storyboard planning. - OpenAI-compatible and deterministic local planners. - Cost estimate and explicit generation approval. - Pippit CLI, China-region Kling CLI, and Mock Provider adapters. - Celery polling with Redis. - Per-user credit reservations and idempotent refunds. - Image, video, and audio uploads with MIME, signature, and size validation. - FFmpeg composition with landscape, vertical, and square deliveries, captions, soundtrack, and cover generation. - Private asset downloads plus time-limited, revocable share links. - Same-origin write validation and separate auth, generation, and upload limits. - An environment-allowlisted administration console for accounts, credits, jobs, invites, runtime switches, and audit logs. - Live production progress and Final Cut visual evaluation. - CI, security scanning, documentation generation, and release builds. - Playwright and Mock Provider end-to-end acceptance without paid generation. 3. Repository Layout VideoAgent/ ├── apps/ │ ├── web/ │ │ ├── messages/ EN/ZH translation resources │ │ ├── public/docs/ generated English and Chinese Docs │ │ ├── src/app/ Next.js routes and API proxy │ │ ├── src/components/ product UI and project workspace │ │ ├── src/i18n/ next-intl routing │ │ └── tests/ ├── packages/landing/ │ ├── src/index.tsx shared product UI │ ├── src/content.ts English and Chinese content │ └── src/landing.css shared visual system ├── services/api/src/videoagent/ │ ├── agent/ graph and planner │ ├── api/ FastAPI routes │ ├── providers/ Pippit, Kling China CLI, Mock │ ├── services/ storyboard, jobs, evaluation │ └── workers/ ├── docs/ paired Markdown sources ├── scripts/build pages.py Markdown and static Docs builder └── .github/workflows/ 4. Runtime Browser ├── Next.js :3000 │ ├── /api/account/ → FastAPI :8000/api/v1 │ └── /docs/ → generated HTML FastAPI ├── SQLite by default ├── LangGraph ├── Pippit CLI └── Kling China CLI Celery Worker ├── Redis broker └── Pippit query-result The browser account and home creation requests use the Next.js Route Handler. The project workspace uses NEXT PUBLIC API BASE URL . 5. Request Flows 5.1 Authentication register/login → normalize email → hash password with Argon2 → create opaque session token → store SHA-256 token hash → set HttpOnly SameSite cookie 5.2 Storyboards PUT /projects/{project id}/storyboard replaces the complete shot list, increments Storyboard.version , and assigns contiguous shot indexes starting at zero. The same replacement persists recurring Character resources and Shot resources. Character generation uses the domestic Kling CLI text to image and image to image tools, validates project-owned image references, reserves credits, and persists the downloaded image as a project asset. 5.3 Agent POST /projects/{project id}/messages → persist user message → assemble bounded Context and short-term Memory → record context / memory / Skill activity → resolve persisted Skill instructions when available → execute LangGraph plan storyboard → validate StoryboardPlan → record planning / validation activity → replace storyboard → record state activity → persist assistant message → record reply activity → return both messages and current storyboard The workspace polls GET /projects/{project id}/agent-activity/{run id} at 350ms and renders the durable event stream as its live Agent trace. 5.4 Generation estimate → POST /shots/{id}/estimate generate → require approved=true → require Idempotency-Key → provider.submit → persist GenerationJob → update Shot → enqueue Celery polling status → GET /jobs/{id} → refresh from Provider when non-terminal 6. Backend Modules Module Responsibility --- --- main.py FastAPI app, lifespan, routers, errors config.py VIDEOAGENT settings models.py SQLAlchemy ORM models schemas.py API and Agent schemas api.auth Account and session flows api.projects Project lifecycle and ownership api.storyboards Storyboard read/replace api.agent Message history and planning api.agent activity Observe one Agent run api.workspace Conversation history, project folders, filing, and staged approval api.generation Estimate, submit, job status api.evaluation Production progress and Final Cut visual review api.providers Pippit status and credits api.assets Uploads, downloads, exports, sharing, and revocation api.skills Skill listing, persistence, and AI optimization api.hots Community video upload, listing, and streaming api.credits Per-user VideoAgent balance api.admin Overview, users, credits, jobs, invites, settings, audit middleware Same-origin write checks and request limits services.media Validation, result materialization, FFmpeg, covers, and sharing services.agent context Bounded conversation, Storyboard, and Skill Context services.agent activity Durable Agent run event recording services.credits Credit accounts, reservations, and refunds services.workflow Concept, outline, script, and ready state transitions services.skill optimizer Structured Skill planning and contract generation providers.pippit CLI process and JSON adaptation providers.kling Kling MCP tool adapter and task mapping providers.kling cli China-region Kling CLI submission, status, identity, and credits providers.mock Deterministic local generation agent.graph One-node LangGraph agent.planner Local/OpenAI-compatible planners 7. Frontend Modules Module Responsibility --- --- packages/landing/src/index.tsx Shared nav, composer, Skills, Videos, Docs packages/landing/src/content.ts English UI and Chinese resources app-landing-page.tsx Product home project creation project-workspace.tsx History navigation, asset tree, canvas, approval-driven Agent chat, generation, and review lib/api.ts Host-aware API URL resolution for localhost and 127.0.0.1 development scripts/build pages.py bilingual Docs build Assets is the unified index for projects and generated media. The product app keeps the landing shell mounted and opens conversations as the hash view /en conversation/{project id} . Project detail pages are not exposed as separate routes; creating, selecting, or returning to a conversation does not trigger a document navigation. 8. Skills Implementation Skills is one flat searchable catalogue. Cards show user id/skill id and preload actionable prompts into the Agents composer. Provider-native capabilities use the provider namespace, while cross-provider workflows use video agent : video agent/search all resources kling/text to video kling/image to video kling/reference to video kling/first last frame kling/motion control kling/video extend kling/video edit video agent/style transfer video agent/video upscale video agent/product film video agent/creator vlog video agent/short drama video agent/review video agent/video localization video agent/batch variants video agent/script assistant video agent/smart preview video agent/camera movement video agent/music video video agent/reference remake video agent/agent handoff Review uses the same card form as other task-oriented Skills. Signed-in users can publish a skill under their own namespace. Public Skills are included in the catalogue for other signed-in users. GET /skills returns likes , uses , is liked , and is mine . Repeated likes and uses are represented by unique rows in skill engagement likes and skill engagement usages , so the same account cannot inflate a leaderboard. The frontend computes uses × 2 + likes × 3 , keeps category filters separate from overall rank, and renders the top-three reward projection. Videos has the equivalent hots likes record, with rank based on unique likes. Production playbooks are defined in packages/landing/src/content.ts with a prompt, Skill, Hook, style, frame, duration, and review mode. Applying one updates the full composer draft; clicking the active playbook again restores the saved pre-playbook composer state. Videos cards carry a Skill ID so scenario reuse enters Agents with the matching Skill selected. 9. Documentation Localization The globe control switches documentation language. English: product-requirements.html Chinese: product-requirements.zh.html The same pattern applies to all nine documents in this order: PRD, Playbook, Arch, API, Dev, Test, Ops, FAQ, and TODO. Docs search uses docs-search.json across both languages. Docs language follows application locale state. 10. Security - Argon2 password hashing. - Opaque session tokens with SHA-256 storage. - HttpOnly and SameSite=Lax cookies. - Ownership checks on projects, shots, and jobs. - Pippit credentials remain server-side. - Kling OAuth state remains inside the MCP connector boundary. - CLI calls use argument arrays and timeouts. - Secret and dependency scanning run in CI. - Unsafe methods validate Origin and Sec-Fetch-Site . - Uploads enforce byte limits and validate declared MIME plus file signatures. - Share tokens are stored as hashes and become unavailable after expiry or revocation. - Collaboration tokens create project membership only after authenticated acceptance. View-only membership is enforced by project mutation endpoints. - Administration access is restricted by VIDEOAGENT ADMIN EMAILS . - Disabling a user immediately revokes existing sessions. - The generation kill switch blocks both estimation and Provider submission. 13. Local Development cd D:\ Science\Agent\VideoAgent .\scripts\dev-api.ps1 .\scripts\dev-web.ps1 Worker: .\scripts\dev-worker.ps1 Local URLs: http://localhost:3000/en http://localhost:8000/docs 14. Testing cd services\api uv run pytest uv run ruff check src tests uv run ruff format --check src tests uv run mypy src cd ..\.. pnpm --dir apps/web test pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck pnpm --dir apps/web build pnpm test:e2e python scripts\build pages.py Backend coverage currently consists of 71 tests, frontend coverage consists of 30 Vitest tests, and Playwright contains seven no-fee browser flows. Playwright uses the Mock Provider for generation and therefore never consumes real Provider credits.

Next.js App Router Web 界面。 - 左侧 Agents、Skills、Videos、Assets、Docs 导航和独立视图切换。 - 蓝色播放键品牌、无框标签页图标和激活图标填充/线框反转。 - 首页连续视频轮播、流式主标语、Skill/Hook 选择器、场景策略、自定义透明下拉和 Action 生成入口。 - 创作输入框根据 scrollHeight 自动增高，并在输入非空时隐藏示例灵感；策略保持可用，重复点击当前项会恢复应用前草稿。 - 模型下拉框使用统一模型元数据，展示 Pippit 8 个、Kling 7 个当前可用的视频模型及 Provider。 - Skills 使用单一可搜索目录，显示 user id/skill id ；原厂商能力使用厂商命名空间（如 kling ），跨 Provider 工作流使用 video agent 。 - Skills 提供分类筛选、综合榜单、点赞和去重使用信号；公开 Skill 对其他登录用户可见，作者不能给自己点赞。 - Videos 支持搜索、循环视频、作者、喜欢数、发布，以及带 Skill 的场景复用。 - Videos 提供分类筛选、去重点赞排名和前三名奖励展示。 - Assets 使用瀑布流，并通过 Video/Skill 内部分页区分类型；Video 卡片悬浮静音播放，Skill 卡片无封面并展示 private/public 和 yyyy-mm-dd 编辑时间。 - 九份中英文文档、全文搜索、统一深色阅读主题、左侧可折叠目录和章节高亮。 - 用户级积分账户、生成预扣与幂等退款。 - 图片、视频和音频上传，MIME、文件头和大小校验。 - FFmpeg 成片合成、字幕、音轨、横竖方版本和封面。 - 私有资产下载、限时分享、撤销和访问计数。 - 同源写请求校验与认证、生成、上传分层限流。 - 管理员邮箱白名单、管理控制台、用户停用、积分调整和任务退款。 - 邀请码注册、开放/邀请/关闭注册策略和全局生成开关。 - 管理操作审计日志。 - Storyboard.version 加一。 3. 根据请求顺序重建 Character 和 Shot。 4. 两类资源的 index 均从 0 开始连续分配。 5.3 Agent 对话 POST /projects/{project id}/messages → 校验 run id → 构建有界 Context 与短时 Memory → 记录 context/memory/skill 活动 → 解析当前用户 Skill 指令（如存在） → 保存 user Message → LangGraph 调用 StoryboardPlanner → 输出 StoryboardPlan → 记录 planning/validation 活动 → 保存或替换 Storyboard → 记录 state 活动 → 保存 assistant Message → 记录 reply 活动 → 返回两条 Message 和最新 Storyboard Agent 图只有一个节点： START → plan storyboard → END 前端以 350ms 轮询 GET /projects/{project id}/agent-activity/{run id} ，把真实 Agent step 渲染为 等待时间线。Context Builder 位于 services/agent context.py ，活动持久化位于 services/agent activity.py 。 5.4 生成任务 用户点击估算 → POST /shots/{shot id}/estimate → Provider 返回 CostEstimate 用户批准生成 → POST /shots/{shot id}/generate → 校验 Idempotency-Key → 调用 Provider.submit → 保存 GenerationJob → 更新 Shot 状态 → 投递 Celery 轮询任务 角色图片使用 POST /characters/{character id}/generate 。服务端校验图片引用、 预扣积分，再调用 Kling 国内版 CLI 的 text to image 或 image to image ； 生成文件写入项目媒体目录并作为可下载 Asset 返回。 如果相同镜头和 Idempotency-Key 已经存在，接口返回已有 Job，HTTP 状态为 200，不会再次提交 Provider。 前端每 5 秒请求一次任务状态。 GET /jobs/{job id} 会在任务未结束时调用 Provider 查询最新状态。 5.5 Celery 轮询 启用 VIDEOAGENT CELERY ENABLED=true 后： 生成接口提交 Job → videoagent.poll generation job.delay(job id) → Worker 加载 Job → 使用服务端 Pippit CLI 配置 → 调用 query-result → 更新 Job 和 Shot → 未结束则指数退避重试 Worker 对已结束的 Job 直接返回，保证重复投递不会继续调用 Provider。 6. 后端模块职责 模块 职责 --- --- main.py FastAPI 应用工厂、生命周期、路由和异常处理器 config.py 环境变量配置 db.py Async SQLAlchemy Engine、Session 和基础建表 models.py ORM 模型 schemas.py API 和 Agent 的 Pydantic 模型 errors.py Pippit CLI Provider 10.1 Provider 选择 VIDEOAGENT VIDEO PROVIDER 支持： 值 行为 --- --- pippit 使用服务端安装并授权的 Pippit CLI auto 当前兼容别名，与 pippit 行为相同 mock 使用本地 Mock，不执行 CLI 或外部生成 默认值为 pippit 。测试环境显式使用 mock 。 10.2 服务端授权 安装 @pippit-dev/cli → pippit-tool-cli login → 浏览器完成 Pippit 授权 → CLI 写入操作系统安全存储 → FastAPI 子进程复用服务端登录状态 CI 可改用 VIDEOAGENT PIPPIT ACCESS KEY ，Provider 只把该值转换为子进程 环境变量 XYQ ACCESS KEY 。它不是用户级凭据，不写入数据库，也不通过 API 返回。 10.3 CLI 调用 PippitVideoProvider 使用参数数组启动子进程，不拼接 Shell 字符串： status → logged in get-credit-balance → total remain amount generate-video → thread id + run id query-result → completed + videos[].download url Provider 将 CLI 输出转换为稳定领域对象： GenerationRequest → generate-video → JSON task reference → ProviderJob task reference → query-result → JobStatus + result URL 子进程标准输出必须是单个 JSON 对象；标准错误和完整参数不返回浏览器。 退出码非 0、无效 JSON、超时和缺少必要 ID 均映射为 Provider 错误。 11. HttpOnly 和 SameSite=Lax。 - Pippit CLI 登录文件放在服务账号可访问但权限受限的位置。 - VIDEOAGENT PIPPIT ACCESS KEY 只来自秘密环境变量。 - CLI 子进程有超时，命令参数不经 Shell 解释。 - 跨用户资源访问统一返回 404。 - 日志和 API 响应不返回 Provider Token。 - 敏感环境变量不得提交到 Git。 - 不安全方法校验 Origin 与 Sec-Fetch-Site 。 - 上传读取有字节上限，并校验声明的 MIME 与文件签名。 - 分享 Token 只保存 SHA-256 哈希，过期或撤销后返回 404。 - 协作 Token 只保存哈希；接受后写入 ProjectCollaborator，view 成员的项目写操作返回 403。 - VIDEOAGENT ADMIN EMAILS 是管理权限的唯一引导来源。 - 普通用户访问 /admin/ 返回 403 ，未登录返回 401 。 - 停用用户时删除其 Session；管理员不能停用自己。 - 生成开关关闭后，估算和提交都返回 503 GENERATION DISABLED 。 13. 本地开发 13.1 启动 API cd D:\ Science\Agent\VideoAgent .\scripts\dev-api.ps1 启动脚本会将 Windows PowerShell、Python 标准输出和代码页切换为 UTF-8，避免中文日志乱码。 默认数据库： services/api/.data/videoagent.db 13.2 启动 Web cd D:\ Science\Agent\VideoAgent .\scripts\dev-web.ps1 该脚本同样会统一控制台编码，并启动 Next.js 开发服务。 访问： http://localhost:3000/en http://localhost:8000/docs 13.3 启动 Celery 先启动 Redis，然后： .\scripts\dev-worker.ps1 同时必须让 API 和 Worker 使用相同的： VIDEOAGENT DATABASE URL VIDEOAGENT CELERY BROKER URL VIDEOAGENT CELERY RESULT BACKEND VIDEOAGENT TOKEN ENCRYPTION KEY 13.4 Docker 基础设施 docker compose -f deploy/docker-compose.yml up -d 启动 PostgreSQL、Redis 和 MinIO。 14. 配置项 变量 CI。本地和生产主机优先使用 pippit-tool-cli login ，避免把长期凭据写入 .env 。 15. 测试与质量门禁 后端： cd services\api uv run pytest uv run ruff format --check src tests uv run ruff check src tests uv run mypy src 前端： pnpm --dir apps/web test pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck pnpm --dir apps/web build 测试组成： - 后端 64 个测试。 - 前端 28 个测试。 - Playwright 7 个端到端测试。 - 后端测试使用临时 SQLite 文件。 - Pippit 测试使用本地 Fake CLI，不访问真实生成网络。 - Kling Provider 测试使用 Fake MCP client，不触发付费生成。 - 前端测试覆盖共享首页、导航、文档加载、自定义下拉、Videos 发布、创作提交、历史目录、逐层审批、Skill AI 优化、持久化发布、分类榜单和点赞状态。 - 工作流批准使用本地即时阶段推进；显式调整和自定义修改才调用远程规划器，减少选项点击等待。 - Agent 语言由项目 Brief 和当前用户 Prompt 自动检测，不直接沿用账户语言。 - Pippit 会将低于模型下限的镜头时长提升到 4 秒并同步估算；Provider 拒绝时返回可读的 502 错误并幂等退款。 - Playwright 使用 Mock Provider 验证审批、生成、导出、分享、Skill 优化，以及 Videos 视频上传和 Assets 详情，不访问付费 Provider。 - 管理测试覆盖白名单权限、积分调整、账号停用、邀请码、注册关闭和生成开关。 - 普通 CI 不执行付费生成。 新增功能必须遵循： 1. 先编写失败测试。 2. 实现最小代码。 3. 重构。 4. 运行相关测试和全部质量门禁。 16. 开发规范 16.1 后端 - 路由层只处理 HTTP 转换和依赖注入。 - 领域逻辑放在 services/ 。 - Provider 细节只放在 providers/ 。 - 所有外部输入由 Pydantic 校验。 - API 错误使用稳定错误码。 - 不能把 Pippit Access Key 或 CLI 登录文件写入日志。 - 新查询必须包含用户所有权条件。 16.2 Agent - LLM 输出必须使用 Pydantic 结构化模型。 - 不在 Agent 中直接执行删除、支付或账号操作。 - 外部生成操作必须经过明确的计费审批。 - Prompt 中上传内容和用户文本均视为不可信。 - 本地规划器必须保持可用，确保无模型环境可以开发。 16.3 Provider - 所有 Provider 实现 VideoProvider 接口。 - Provider 错误必须转换为稳定的业务错误。 - 生成提交禁止无幂等保护地重试。 - 查询失败可以退避重试。 - 原始响应与标准化响应分开保存。 16.4 前端 - 服务端状态使用 TanStack Query 或页面级异步加载。 - 临时交互状态使用 React state/Zustand。 - 新文案必须同时进入 en.json 和 zh-CN.json 。 - 优先使用语义标签和可访问控件。 - 动效必须支持 prefers-reduced-motion 。 - Pippit 凭据不得进入 localStorage 或浏览器状态。 17. 扩展点 新增视频 Provider 1. 实现 VideoProvider 。 2. 将 Provider 错误映射为领域错误。 3. 增加 Provider Contract 测试。 4. 在 Provider Resolver 中增加选择逻辑。 5. 增加前端能力展示和积分字段。 新增 Agent 节点 1. 在 AgentState 中增加类型化状态。 2. 为该状态迁移编写单元测试。 3. 将节点加入 StateGraph 。 4. 保持节点幂等。 5. 涉及外部长任务时交给 Celery，不在图节点内阻塞等待。 新增 API 1. 在 schemas.py 增加输入输出模型。 2. 在 services/ 增加业务逻辑。 3. 在 api/ 增加薄路由。 4. 增加所有权和未授权测试。 5. 更新本文档和 OpenAPI 调用方。 19. 提交流程检查清单 - 功能有对应失败测试和通过测试。 - 新接口包含鉴权与资源所有权校验。 - 新文案中英文 Key 一致。 - 没有提交 .env 、Token、上传媒体或本地数据库。 - Ruff、mypy、pytest、TypeScript、Vitest 和 Next Build 通过。 - 新增外部依赖已写入锁文件。 - 新增配置已写入 .env.example 。 - 设计或实现边界变化已更新本文档。

text: VideoAgent Testing and TDD Attribute Value --- --- Document version v2.5 Updated 2026-11-05 Frameworks pytest, Vitest, Testing Library, Playwright 1. Purpose This document defines the automated test strategy, contracts, quality gates, and acceptance checks for the VideoAgent system. 2. TDD Rules 1. Add one failing behavior test. 2. Implement the smallest change that passes. 3. Refactor without changing public behavior. 4. Run all relevant quality gates before commit. Tests assert public behavior, API contracts, ownership, state transitions, and user-visible outcomes rather than private implementation details. 3. Test Layers Unit and component tests → Provider and API contract tests → SQLite integration tests → Playwright and Mock Provider browser E2E External paid generation is never part of normal CI. 4. Coverage Backend: - Password hashing and session behavior. - Project ownership, rename, and archive. - Storyboard replacement and versioning. - Agent planning with deterministic and fake LLM behavior. - Mock, Pippit, and Kling Provider contracts. - Estimate, approval, idempotency, and job status. - Provider status and credits. - Health endpoint. - Instant storyboard evaluation. - Media MIME, signature, size, and ownership validation. - FFmpeg composition, delivery, cover generation, sharing, expiry, and revocation. - User credit reservation, failure refunds, and idempotent ledger entries. - Same-origin write validation and authentication rate limiting. - Administrator email allowlists and non-admin denial. - User disablement, session revocation, and credit adjustment. - Invite creation, consumption, revocation, and registration modes. - Generation kill switch, job refunds, and audit logs. - China-region Kling CLI submission, status mapping, identity, and credits. - Public Skill discovery, like toggling, de-duplicated uses, and author self-like rejection. - Videos like toggling, account de-duplication, persistence, and removal. Frontend: - Shared landing structure and navigation. - Sequenced and looping hero headline. - Search composer and custom settings dropdowns. - Project creation flow. - Assets, Videos, and Docs view switching. - Assets permission, date, hover preview, and cover behavior. - Videos author, likes, playback, and publishing. - Skill and Videos category filters, leaderboard order, and like interaction; individual cards show neither rank nor reward. - English-to-Chinese Docs switching. - Project list, authentication form, and project workspace. - Project uploads, film export, MP4 download, and share-link creation. - Administration console loading, settings changes, and denied access. 5. Provider Contract Tests Every VideoProvider verifies: - Provider name is stable. - Estimate returns normalized credits and duration. - Submit returns a stable task reference. - Status maps to pending , submitted , queued , running , succeeded , failed , or cancelled . - Errors do not expose credentials or full sensitive command arguments. - The same idempotency key does not submit twice. Pippit tests use a local fake CLI and cover status, credits, submit, query, timeout, missing binary, invalid JSON, and missing task IDs. Kling tests use a fake MCP client and cover text-to-video, image-to-video, motion control, task-state mapping, and result extraction. 6. API Tests Required assertions: - Authentication and ownership. - Response status and schema. - Stable error codes. - Explicit generation approval. - Idempotency behavior. - Storyboard replacement ordering. - Shot IDs, generated assets, and history remain intact after reordering. - Agent message persistence. - Production progress percentage and Final Cut visual-review response shape. - No provider credentials in responses. 7. Frontend Tests Component tests cover: - Left navigation with isolated views. - Custom dropdown rendering and selection. - Action button enabled and disabled states. - Videos metadata order: title above author and likes. - Every Videos card contains an autoplaying muted looping video. - Publish entry uses the blue play icon. - Skills is one searchable catalogue with user id/skill id labels; provider-native capabilities use the provider namespace. - Production playbooks fill the prompt and recommended Skill, Hook, style, frame, duration, and review settings. - Re-clicking the active playbook restores the prior composer state. - Videos scenario cards open Agents with the corresponding Skill and prompt. - The textarea grows with multiline content, and idea suggestions disappear while the prompt contains non-whitespace text. - The Model selector includes every available Kling and Pippit video model in Provider/Model format. - Docs labels are PRD , Playbook , Arch , API , Dev , Test , Ops , FAQ , and TODO . - Docs opens PRD by default; search sits above the left document directory, which matches expanded navigation width and supports resizing or collapse. - Globe control changes Docs source and language. - Skills, Videos, Assets, and Docs search controls stay pinned while content scrolls. - Assets switches between Video and Skill tabs without repeating type labels. - Video assets preview on hover; Skill assets have no cover. - Composer menus stay inside the viewport. - Conversation history shows Projects and Recents; folders support creation, rename, deletion, and drag-to-file organization. - Dragging a Recent into a project folder persists the relationship, removes the item from Recents, and renders it as an indented folder child. - Selecting a conversation updates only the URL hash and preserves the mounted application shell; no document navigation occurs. - The workspace tree exposes peer Directions , Visions , and Versions groups; legacy Storyboard, Media, and Exports groups are absent. Projects, Recents, and their conversation items remain text-only. - Characters and Scenes own their descriptions and uploaded references; each Shot opens one combined page. Empty directories do not render waiting copy. - Settings renders Q&A as question-answer attribute rows without the retired lower stage cards. - Settings extracts semantic Attribute / Value clues and excludes approval decisions instead of rendering raw Q&A text. - Settings, Outlines, Scripts, Shot, Character, and Scene editors persist changes through their project or resource endpoints. - Uploads append @<asset-id to the active Prompt; generation infers image-to-video or image-to-image from that reference. - Uploaded and generated results appear under their directory with a persisted final-selection checkbox, copy-ID, preview, and delete action. - Desktop panes default to equal widths and expose draggable separators. - The profile popover contains an inline Languages row with vertically stacked options plus notifications and credits above the avatar and username trigger; account actions carry icons and the gear remains inside the avatar row. - Browser titles are exactly VideoAgent ; the administration runtime label is Pippit China . - Assets and Agents collapse independently and restore from their labeled rails. - The editor header renders no production progress bar and no storyboard “Review” score button. - Final Cut review is available only for exported assets, lets the user choose a configured vision evaluator and consistency metrics, and is unavailable when no evaluator is configured. - Export is blocked until every storyboard Shot has a generated result. - A conversational instruction such as “Render the final cut” triggers delivery generation; no separate render button is exposed in the editor. - Shot estimation and generation return 409 VISION OBJECTS REQUIRED until the storyboard has at least one Character and one Scene. - Model selectors appear on Character and Shot pages, default to the project configuration, and send explicit task-level overrides. - Project sharing creates a collaboration link with view/edit access and an optional email restriction; accepted collaborators can open the project. - An exported final cut can be published to Videos without uploading it again. - Videos use the film-reel icon everywhere; Skills use the camera icon. - Shot generation displays an approval requirement until the story workflow reaches the approved state. - Persisted Agent messages render statically; only a newly returned reply uses the type-on effect and does not replay after the Agents rail is reopened. - Agent requests show a live execution trace, with the compact Thinking spinner retained as the initial fallback before events arrive. - Agent requests persist ordered context , memory , skill , planning , validation , state , and reply events under the client-provided run ID. - The Agents panel renders those events as a live execution trace and remains accurate when a Skill or MCP tool was not called. - Context Builder uses at most eight prior messages, clips each to 600 characters, excludes the current request, and caps Storyboard context at 20 Shots. - Stage approval options cover overall direction, episode and shot outline, and scene script; custom instructions keep the current stage. - Shot estimation and generation remain disabled until the script is approved. - Character Generation supports upload, image-to-image, and text-to-image; generated images are persisted as downloadable project assets. - Skill Studio captures purpose, instructions, quality gates, starter prompt, and input/output contracts. - AI optimization converts a rough idea into a structured draft, and saved Skills reload from the server. - video agent/skill synthesis opens Skill Studio directly. - The app navigation collapses to an icon-only rail, and signed-in Agents views list recent conversations. - Videos publishing requires an MP4 and the post appears in the author's Assets. - Skill and Videos order remains stable across category filters, and like buttons toggle state while updating the displayed count. Cards show category after the title without rank or earned-credit labels. - Assets video and Skill cards open detail dialogs, with video playback. - Workflow approvals advance immediately, and Agent language follows the project brief and user prompt. - Long briefs are split into directing attributes; the English workspace omits Chinese examples and no longer uses Creative brief or Director direction as fallback labels. - Login and registration use the same dark visual language as the product. - Projects opens the project form from its plus action; Recents starts a new Agents conversation; both groups remain collapsible. - Pippit normalizes sub-four-second requests and surfaces provider failures while refunding reserved credits. - Search, language, notifications, credits, and avatar controls use translucent surfaces. - Docs is positioned beside the fixed navigation and its document iframe loads without being covered by decoration or background layers. - Avatar opens login and registration when signed out and sign-out when signed in. - API starts with its metadata table. - FAQ and TODO have paired English and Chinese documents. Playwright uses the real Next.js UI, FastAPI service, SQLite, and Mock Provider to verify: register → home prompt → create project → three approvals → upload references → generate every shot → collaboration link → render final cut → download/share → publish An additional no-fee Skill flow verifies: register → Skills → rough idea → AI optimize → publish → reload The no-fee Videos and Assets flow is: register → Videos → upload MP4 → publish → Assets → open details and play This flow never calls a paid Provider and is a required Pull Request gate. The administration E2E covers administrator sign-in, console loading, and generation pause. Backend integration tests cover non-admin 403 responses, credit adjustments, account disablement, invite registration, and audit logs. 8. Responsive and Accessibility Checks - Keyboard access for navigation, dropdowns, Docs, and dialogs. - Visible focus states. - Sufficient text size and contrast. - Reduced-motion support. - Desktop sidebar and mobile navigation remain usable. - Long English and Chinese text do not overlap. 9. CI Gates Pull requests must pass: Ruff check and formatting mypy strict checks pytest Vitest TypeScript check Next.js production build Docs and static artifact build Playwright with Mock Provider E2E secret and dependency scans 10. Provider Verification Read-only 1. Install and authenticate pippit-tool-cli . 2. Run status and get-credit-balance . 3. Query /providers/pippit and /providers/pippit/credits . 4. Verify logs omit access keys. 5. Verify China-region Kling CLI who am i confirms authorization, account region, and model discovery. Authorized paid generation Only with explicit user approval and budget: 1. Record starting credits. 2. Submit one minimal task. 3. Verify the idempotency key and Provider task reference. 4. Poll to completion. 5. Record result, credits, and UI/API consistency. 6. Do not automatically retry an uncertain submission. 11. Definition of Done - Tests were written before implementation or alongside a documented regression case. - Relevant local tests pass. - Ruff, mypy, TypeScript, Next build, and Docs build pass. - No secrets, local databases, or generated media are committed. - API and UI documentation are updated when behavior changes. - Paid Provider tests remain opt-in.

text: VideoAgent 软件测试与 TDD 规范 属性 内容 --- --- 文档版本 v2.5 更新日期 2026-11-05 测试框架 pytest、Vitest、Testing Library、Playwright 1. 目的 本文档定义 VideoAgent 的自动化测试策略、契约、质量门禁与验收检查。 2. TDD 规则 1. 先编写一个失败的行为测试。 2. 编写足以通过测试的最小实现。 3. 在不改变公开行为的前提下重构。 4. 提交前执行完整质量门禁。 测试关注公开行为、API 契约、权限、状态迁移和用户可见结果，不绑定私有实现细节。 3. 测试分层 单元与组件测试 → Provider 与 API 契约测试 → SQLite 集成测试 → Playwright + Mock Provider 浏览器 E2E 真实付费生成不进入普通 CI。 4. 覆盖范围 后端： - 密码哈希与会话行为。 - 项目所有权、重命名和归档。 - 故事板替换与版本。 - 确定性 Planner 与 Fake LLM 的 Agent 规划。 - Mock、Pippit 和 Kling Provider 契约。 - 积分估算、审批、幂等和任务状态。 - Provider 状态与积分。 - 健康检查。 - 制作进度与 Final Cut 视觉评估。 - 媒体 MIME、文件头、大小校验和用户所有权。 - FFmpeg 合成、导出、封面生成、分享、过期和撤销。 - 用户积分预扣、失败退款与幂等流水。 - 同源写请求校验及认证限流。 - 管理员邮箱白名单与普通用户拒绝访问。 - 用户停用、Session 撤销和积分调整。 - 邀请码创建、消费、撤销和注册模式。 - 生成 kill switch、任务退款和审计日志。 - 国内版 Kling CLI 的提交参数、状态映射、账号身份和积分读取。 - Skill 公开发现、点赞切换、使用去重和作者禁止自赞。 - Videos 点赞切换、账户去重、统计持久化和取消点赞。 前端： - 共享 Landing 结构与导航。 - 流式主标题和视频轮播。 - 创作框与自定义下拉。 - 项目创建流程。 - Assets、Videos 和 Docs 视图切换。 - Assets 权限、日期、悬浮预览与封面行为。 - Videos 作者、喜欢数、播放和发布。 - Skills 与 Videos 分类筛选、榜单顺序和点赞交互；单卡不显示排名或奖励。 - Docs 中英文切换。 - 项目列表、认证表单与项目工作区。 - 项目素材上传、成片导出、MP4 下载和分享链接。 - 管理控制台加载、设置切换和权限拒绝页面。 5. Provider 契约测试 每个 VideoProvider 验证： - Provider 名称稳定。 - 积分估算返回标准化积分与时长。 - 提交返回稳定任务引用。 - 状态映射为 pending 、 submitted 、 queued 、 running 、 succeeded 、 failed 或 cancelled 。 - 错误不暴露凭据或完整敏感命令参数。 - 相同幂等键不会重复提交。 Pippit 测试使用本地 Fake CLI，覆盖状态、积分、提交、查询、超时、缺失二进制、 无效 JSON 和缺失任务 ID。Kling 测试使用 Fake MCP Client，覆盖文生视频、 图生视频、动作控制、任务状态映射和结果提取。 Kling 国内版另使用依赖注入测试覆盖 text to video 、 query tasks 、 who am i 和 account ，测试不实际提交生成任务。 6. API 测试 必须验证： - 认证与所有权。 - 响应状态码和 Schema。 - 稳定错误码。 - 显式生成审批。 - 幂等行为。 - 故事板替换后的镜头顺序。 - 镜头排序后 Shot ID、生成资产和历史保持不变。 - Agent 消息持久化。 - 评估结果结构。 - 响应不包含 Provider 凭据。 7. 前端测试 组件测试覆盖： - 左侧独立视图导航。 - 自定义下拉渲染与选择。 - Action 启用和禁用状态。 - Videos 元数据顺序：标题在作者与喜欢数之上。 - 每张 Videos 卡片包含自动播放、静音、循环视频。 - 发布入口使用蓝色播放键。 - Skills 使用 user id/skill id 的单一搜索目录，原厂商能力使用厂商命名空间。 - 策略正确填充提示词、Skill、Hook、风格、画幅、时长和审核设置。 - 再次点击当前策略会恢复应用前状态。 - Videos 场景卡片进入 Agents 时选中对应 Skill 和提示词。 - 输入框随多行内容增高，输入非空时隐藏示例灵感。 - Model 目录包含全部 Kling 与 Pippit 视频模型，并显示为 服务商/模型 。 - Docs 标签为 PRD 、 策略 、 Arch 、 API 、 Dev 、 Test 、 Ops 、 FAQ 、 TODO 。 - Docs 每次进入默认打开 PRD；搜索框位于目录上方，左侧文档目录默认与展开导航等宽， 可拖拽或使用方向键调整，也可收起为图标栏。 - Globe 控件切换 Docs 语言。 - Skills、Videos、Assets、Docs 搜索框保持固定。 - Assets 通过 Video/Skill 分页切换，不重复类型标签。 - Video 悬浮预览，Skill 卡片无封面。 - 创作框菜单不超出视口。 - 历史导航展示 Projects 与 Recents，项目目录支持创建、重命名、删除和拖拽收纳。 - 将 Recent 拖入项目目录后关系持久化，Recent 列表移除该项，并在目录内以缩进子项显示。 - 点击历史对话只更新 URL 哈希并复用已挂载的应用外壳，不触发页面级导航。 - 工作区资源树提供同级的 Directions 、 Visions 和 Versions ，不再显示 Storyboard、Media、Exports。Projects、Recents 及其对话项保持纯文本。 - Character 与 Scene 各自承接描述和上传参考图；每个 Shot 直接打开合并页面，目录行不使用容器框。 空目录不显示等待文案。 - Settings 以“问题-答案”属性行展示 Q&A，不显示旧版底部分阶段卡片。 - Settings 从对话提炼 属性 / 值 ，排除批准消息，不直接展示原始 Q&A。 - Settings、Outlines、Scripts、Shot、Character 与 Scene 的修改分别通过项目或资源接口持久化。 - 上传素材会把 @<asset-id 追加到当前 Prompt；生成时根据该 ID 自动选择参考模式。 - 上传和生成结果位于对应目录，支持最终选用、复制 ID、预览和删除。 - 桌面端四栏默认等宽并支持拖拽调整；头像下拉包含语言、通知和积分，语言选项纵向排列； 账号操作带图标，齿轮位于头像行内部。 - 浏览器标题统一为 VideoAgent ；管理后台运行环境标签为 Pippit China 。 - Assets 与 Agents 可独立折叠，并通过带标签的窄轨恢复。 - 编辑区顶部不显示制作进度条，也不显示故事板 Review 分数按钮。 - Final Cut 视觉评估只对导出资产开放，用户可选择已配置的视觉模型和一致性指标；未配置模型时明确不可用。 - 全部故事板 Shot 均生成后才可导出成片。 - 通过“生成成片”等对话指令触发交付生成；编辑区不单独暴露合成按钮。 - 故事板缺少 Character 或 Scene 时，镜头估算与生成返回 409 VISION OBJECTS REQUIRED 。 - Character 与 Shot 页面展示模型选择器，默认继承项目配置，并能发送任务级覆盖。 - 项目分享生成查看或编辑权限的协作链接，可限制受邀邮箱；接受后可直接打开项目。 - 已导出成片可直接发布到 Videos，无需再次上传文件。 - Videos 在所有入口统一使用胶卷图标，Skills 统一使用摄像机图标。 - 镜头生成在工作流批准前显示明确提示。 - 历史 Agent 消息静态渲染；仅新返回的回复执行一次流式显示，Agents 折叠后重新展开不会重复播放。 - Agent 请求等待回复时显示实时执行轨迹；事件到达前的短暂空档保留紧凑的 Thinking 加载状态。 - Agent 请求按客户端 run id 持久化 context 、 memory 、 skill 、 planning 、 validation 、 state 和 reply 有序事件。 - Agents 面板将事件显示为实时执行轨迹；未发生的 Skill 或 MCP 调用不得显示为已执行。 - Context Builder 最多读取 8 条历史消息，每条截断至 600 字符，排除当前请求， 故事板上下文最多包含 20 个 Shot。 - Agent 逐层展示整体设定、分集/分镜大纲和逐场剧本审批选项，自定义意见保持当前阶段。 - 只有剧本批准后才允许估算和生成镜头。 - 角色生成页支持上传、参考图生图和文字生图；生成图片持久化为可下载的项目资产。 - Skill 发布表单包含用途、执行规范、质量门禁、启动提示词和输入输出契约。 - AI 优化按钮能把粗略想法整理为结构化 Skill，保存后从服务端恢复。 - 内置 video agent/skill synthesis 直接打开 Skill Studio。 - App 左侧导航可收起为仅图标，登录后 Agents 首页显示最近对话。 - Videos 发布必须选择 MP4，上传成功后出现在社区和作者 Assets。 - Skills 与 Videos 在分类筛选后保持榜单顺序，点赞按钮正确切换状态并更新计数；卡片只 在标题后显示分类，不显示排名或获得积分。 - Assets 的视频与 Skill 卡片可点击打开详情，视频详情可播放。 - 工作流批准立即推进；Agent 回复语言跟随项目 Brief 和用户 Prompt。 - 长 Brief 拆分为多个导演属性；英文界面不显示中文例句， Creative brief 和 Director direction 不再作为兜底属性。 - 登录、注册与主产品使用一致的深色视觉语言。 - Projects 的加号打开项目表单；Recents 的加号进入 Agents；两组都可展开和收起。 - Pippit 低于 4 秒的请求会被规范化，Provider 拒绝会显示原始失败原因并返还预留积分。 - 搜索、语言、通知、积分和头像使用半透明表面。 - Docs 位于固定导航右侧，文档 iframe 正常加载且不会被装饰或背景层遮挡。 - 头像在未登录时提供登录与注册，登录后提供退出。 - API 文档开头展示属性表。 - FAQ 与 TODO 均有中英文版本。 Playwright 使用真实 Next.js 页面、FastAPI、SQLite 和 Mock Provider，验证： 注册 → 首页创意 → 创建项目 → 三轮审批 → 上传参考素材 → 生成全部镜头 → 创建协作链接 → 合成成片 → 下载/分享 → 发布 另有一条无费用 Skill 链路： 注册 → Skills → 输入粗略想法 → AI 优化 → 发布 → 刷新后恢复 无费用 Videos / Assets 链路： 注册 → Videos → 上传 MP4 → 发布 → Assets → 查看详情并播放 该链路不调用真实付费 Provider，应作为每个 Pull Request 的必过门禁。 管理后台 E2E 验证管理员登录、控制台加载和暂停生成；后端集成测试验证普通用户 返回 403 、积分调整、账号停用、邀请码注册和审计日志。 8. 响应式与可访问性 - 导航、下拉、Docs 和弹窗可用键盘操作。 - 工作区最小字号不低于按钮字号。 - 焦点样式清晰。 - 字号和对比度充足。 - 支持 prefers-reduced-motion 。 - 桌面侧栏和移动导航可用。 - 中英文长文本不重叠。 9. CI 门禁 Pull Request 必须通过： Ruff 检查与格式检查 mypy 严格类型检查 pytest Vitest TypeScript 检查 Next.js 生产构建 Docs 与静态产物构建 Playwright + Mock Provider E2E 敏感信息和依赖扫描 10. Provider 验证 只读检查 1. 安装并认证 pippit-tool-cli 。 2. 执行 status 与 get-credit-balance 。 3. 查询 /providers/pippit 和 /providers/pippit/credits 。 4. 验证日志不包含 Access Key。 5. 使用 Kling 国内版 CLI who am i 验证授权、账号区域和模型发现。 获准的付费生成 仅在用户明确批准预算时： 1. 记录起始积分。 2. 提交一个最小任务。 3. 验证幂等键和 Provider Task Reference。 4. 轮询到完成。 5. 记录结果、积分和 UI/API 状态一致性。 6. 不确定提交禁止自动重试。 11. 完成定义 - 测试先于实现，或与已记录的回归用例同步编写。 - 相关本地测试通过。 - Ruff、mypy、TypeScript、Next Build 和 Docs Build 通过。 - 不提交密钥、本地数据库或生成媒体。 - 行为变化同步更新 API 与 UI 文档。 - 付费 Provider 测试保持人工开启。

text: VideoAgent Operations Strategy Attribute Value --- --- Document version v2.3 Updated 2026-11-05 Scope Skills, Videos, Assets, providers, support, metrics 1. Operating Model VideoAgent operates three content layers: 1. Provider-native Skills and cross-provider workflows under their respective kling , pippit , or video agent namespaces. 2. User-published Skills and Videos entries. 3. Project outputs stored in Assets. 2. Release Readiness - Complete authentication and credit-usage acceptance. - Verify Pippit CLI authorization and Kling China-region CLI OAuth. - Publish PRD, Playbook, Arch, API, Dev, Test, Ops, FAQ, and TODO. - Verify English and Chinese Docs switching. - Verify project creation, storyboard planning, generation approval, and job polling with the configured provider. - Verify upload, generated-result materialization, FFmpeg delivery, download, and share revocation. - Verify per-user credit reservation, failure refunds, and Provider-account reconciliation. - Run Playwright with the Mock Provider as a no-fee end-to-end release gate. - Confirm provider credentials never appear in browser bundles, logs, or API responses. - Configure VIDEOAGENT ADMIN EMAILS and verify at least one administrator can sign in. 3. Official Skill Operations - Provider-native capabilities use their provider namespace, such as kling ; cross-provider workflows use video agent . - Skill IDs are stable, lowercase, and underscore-separated. - Every Skill states its input, output, provider dependency, and credit impact. - Skill changes update PRD, Playbook, Arch, and Test. - Deprecated Skills remain listed for one release with a migration note. - Scenario playbooks reference current Skills and stay aligned with composer fields. - External Agent handoff uses an explicit MCP or CLI contract. 3.1 Skill and Videos Leaderboards - Skills use six categories: Generation, Story, Workflow, Post, Review, and Utility. Videos uses Vlog, Product, Drama, Music, Localization, and Campaign. - Category filters change the visible subset without changing overall rank. Skills can sort by combined signal, uses, likes, or recency; Videos can sort by likes or recency. - Skill score is unique account uses × 2 + unique account likes × 3 . Videos ranks by unique account likes. Ties compare likes, uses, then update time. - One account contributes at most one like or use signal per item. Authors cannot like their own content. - The Skills top three display 500, 300, and 150 credit rewards. The Videos top three display 300, 180, and 100. Campaign duration, budget, and final eligibility are configured per operating cycle. - Rewards are issued through audited administrator credit adjustments. The client leaderboard is a projection and is not an authorization to pay. - For suspected manipulation, pause settlement, review accounts, timestamps, devices, and publication history, remove confirmed invalid interactions, and retain the operating audit trail. 4. Asset Operations - Assets contains only the current user's work. - Public and private permissions are explicit. - Edit dates use yyyy-mm-dd . - Video assets preview on hover; Skill assets have no cover. - Video and Skill use internal tabs rather than repeated type labels. - Uploaded and delivered assets are user-scoped. Share links are time-limited by default and can be revoked. - Check Asset, share-link, and project references before deleting media. 5. Provider and Cost Operations - Pippit CLI and Kling China-region CLI are available through the provider boundary. - Billable generation requires explicit user approval. - Provider submission uses database idempotency keys. - Credits and provider status are read server-side. - The product displays each user's VideoAgent quota instead of the shared Provider account pool. - Generation reserves user credits before submission and refunds them idempotently after submit failure, job failure, or cancellation. - Monitor provider errors, timeout rate, uncertain submissions, and duplicate protection. - Preserve provider task references for reconciliation. 5.1 Administration Console - Administration URL: /en/admin . - Keep new-user credits at zero for launch and grant them through user administration. - Use invite mode before opening registration; switch to closed mode during an incident. - Pause generation before investigating Provider, billing, or security issues. - Failed, cancelled, and uncertain jobs can be refunded idempotently by Job ID. - Account, credit, invite, and settings mutations are recorded in the audit log. - The administrator allowlist is environment-owned and requires an API restart after changes. 6. Release Procedure 1. Run backend tests, frontend tests, Playwright E2E, type checks, builds, and Docs generation. 2. Check secret scanning and dependency security results. 3. Confirm provider status and credit balance without spending credits. 4. Validate English and Chinese Docs, search, navigation, and responsive layout. 5. Record the release commit. 7. Monitoring - Registration and login success rate. - Project creation success rate. - Storyboard generation success and latency. - Generation approval-to-submit conversion. - Provider success, failure, timeout, and uncertain-submit rate. - Duplicate generation prevented by idempotency. - Credit consumption per project. - Reservations, refunds, and unresolved credit holds. - Upload rejection rate, export latency, and share access or revocation counts. - Docs search usage and broken document links. 8. Support Support triage order: 1. Authentication and session failures. 2. Provider unavailable or authorization failures. 3. Credit and billing anomalies. 4. Job state or duplicate submission concerns. 5. Search, Docs, and navigation defects. 6. Visual and copy issues. Support never asks users for access keys, cookies, or CLI session files. 9. Incident Response - Disable billable generation before retrying an uncertain provider incident. - Preserve job records and provider task references. - Roll back the web release independently from provider credentials. - Publish a status note with affected areas and mitigation. - Review billing, duplicate jobs, cross-user access, and audit evidence. - Revoke exposed share tokens immediately and inspect anomalous access counts. - For suspicious registration or credit use: pause generation, close registration, disable accounts, and inspect jobs plus audit logs. 10. Success Metrics - Activation: first project created within the first session. - Creation: successful storyboard within five minutes. - Final Cut review: percentage of exported films with a completed visual evaluation. - Reliability: generation jobs reaching a terminal state. - Cost: credit usage per completed project. - Content: Skill category distribution, unique likes, unique uses, leaderboard conversion, Videos unique likes, and campaign reward cost. - Documentation: search success and zero broken bilingual links.

text: VideoAgent 运营策略 属性 内容 --- --- 文档版本 v2.3 更新日期 2026-11-05 范围 Skills、Videos、Assets、Provider、支持、指标 1. 运营模型 VideoAgent 按三层内容运营： 1. 原厂商 Skill 与跨 Provider 工作流，分别使用 kling 、 pippit 或 video agent 命名空间。 2. 用户发布的 Skill 与 Videos 作品。 3. 项目产出的 Assets 成品与半成品。 2. 发布准备 - 完成认证和积分消耗验收。 - 确认 Pippit CLI 授权与 Kling 国内版 CLI OAuth。 - 发布 PRD、策略、Arch、API、Dev、Test、Ops、FAQ、TODO 九份文档。 - 验证中英文文档切换。 - 验证项目创建、故事板规划、生成审批和任务轮询。 - 验证上传、生成结果落地、FFmpeg 合成、下载与分享撤销。 - 验证用户积分预扣、失败退款和 Provider 账户对账。 - 执行 Playwright + Mock Provider 无费用 E2E。 - 确认浏览器包、日志和 API 响应中不存在 Provider 凭据。 - 配置 VIDEOAGENT ADMIN EMAILS 并确认至少一个管理员账号可登录。 3. 官方 Skill 运营 - 原厂商能力使用厂商 user id（如 kling ）；跨 Provider 工作流使用 video agent 。 - Skill ID 稳定、小写，并使用下划线分隔。 - 每个 Skill 说明输入、输出、Provider 依赖和积分影响。 - Skill 变更同步更新 PRD、策略、Arch 和 Test。 - 废弃 Skill 至少保留一个版本并给出迁移说明。 - 场景策略引用有效 Skill，并与创作框字段保持一致。 - 外部 Agent 接力使用明确的 MCP 或 CLI 契约。 3.1 Skill 与 Videos 榜单 - Skills 固定使用六个分类：生成、叙事、工作流、后期、评估、工具；Videos 固定使用 Vlog、产品、短剧、音乐、本地化、营销。 - 分类筛选只改变当前视图，不改变总榜排名。Skills 可按综合热度、使用数、点赞数和 最新发布排序；Videos 可按点赞数和发布时间排序。 - Skill 综合分为 去重账户使用数 × 2 + 去重账户点赞数 × 3 ；Videos 只按去重点赞数 排名。分数相同时依次比较点赞数、使用数和更新时间。 - 同一账户对同一内容最多保留一条点赞或使用记录；作者不能给自己的内容点赞。 - Skills 榜单前三名展示 500、300、150 积分奖励，Videos 榜单前三名展示 300、180、 100 积分奖励。运营周期、预算和最终名单由当期活动配置决定。 - 奖励发放通过管理后台逐笔调整积分并记录原因，不直接信任前端榜单结果。结算前需 复核异常增长、批量账号、重复发布和内容下架状态。 - 发现刷榜时先冻结当期结算，再结合用户、互动时间、设备与发布记录复核；确认违规 后移除互动并记录运营审计。 4. Assets 运营 - Assets 只展示当前用户自己的作品。 - 每项明确 private 或 public。 - 编辑日期统一使用 yyyy-mm-dd 。 - Video 卡片悬浮预览，Skill 卡片不显示封面。 - Video 与 Skill 通过内部分页区分，不在卡片上重复类型标签。 - 上传和导出资产按用户隔离；分享链接默认限时 24 小时，支持主动撤销。 - 清理媒体前先检查 Asset、分享链接和项目引用，避免不可恢复的断链。 5. Provider 与成本运营 - Pippit CLI 与 Kling 国内版 CLI 通过统一 Provider 边界提供能力。 - 计费生成必须获得用户明确批准。 - Provider 提交使用数据库幂等键。 - 积分和 Provider 状态由服务端读取。 - 产品界面展示用户独立 VideoAgent 配额，不直接暴露共享 Provider 积分池。 - 生成成功前预扣用户配额；提交失败、生成失败或取消时执行幂等退款。 - 监控 Provider 错误率、超时率、不确定提交和重复提交拦截。 - 保留 Provider Task Reference 以支持对账。 5.1 管理后台 - 管理入口： /en/admin 。 - 上线前将新用户初始积分设为 0 ，通过用户管理逐个发放。 - 公开注册前可使用邀请模式；紧急情况下切换为关闭注册。 - Provider 异常或费用异常时，先暂停生成，再排查任务和余额。 - 失败、取消或提交不确定任务可人工退款；退款按 Job ID 幂等。 - 所有账号、积分、邀请和设置变更均记录在管理审计日志中。 - 管理员白名单保存在环境变量，变更后需要重启 API 服务。 6. 发布流程 1. 运行后端测试、前端测试、Playwright E2E、类型检查、构建和文档生成。 2. 检查敏感信息和依赖安全扫描。 3. 只读检查 Provider 状态和积分。 4. 验证中英文 Docs、搜索、导航和响应式布局。 5. 记录发布 Commit。 7. 监控指标 - 注册和登录成功率。 - 项目创建成功率。 - 故事板生成成功率和耗时。 - 审批到任务提交转化率。 - Provider 成功、失败、超时和不确定提交比例。 - 幂等键拦截的重复任务数。 - 单项目积分消耗。 - 用户预扣、退款和未完成预留数量。 - 上传拒绝率、导出耗时、分享链接访问与撤销次数。 - 文档搜索使用量和失效链接。 8. 用户支持 问题优先级： 1. 登录和 Session 异常。 2. Provider 不可用或授权异常。 3. 积分和计费异常。 4. 任务状态或重复提交风险。 5. 搜索、文档和导航问题。 6. 视觉与文案问题。 不得要求用户提供 Access Key、Cookie 或 CLI 登录文件。 9. 故障处理 - Provider 状态不确定时先停止计费生成，再排查。 - 保留任务记录和 Provider Task ID。 - Web 发布可独立回滚，不覆盖 Provider 凭据。 - 发布状态说明，明确受影响能力与缓解措施。 - 复盘重复扣费、跨用户访问和审计证据缺失。 - 分享 Token 泄露时立即撤销链接，并检查异常访问计数。 - 发现异常注册或积分消耗时：暂停生成 → 关闭注册 → 停用账号 → 检查审计与任务。 10. 成功指标 - 激活：首次会话内完成项目创建。 - 创作：五分钟内生成故事板。 - Final Cut 评估：已导出成片完成视觉评估的比例。 - 可靠性：生成任务进入终态的比例。 - 成本：完成项目对应的积分消耗。 - 内容：Skill 分类分布、去重点赞、去重使用、榜单转化率、Videos 去重点赞和当期奖励 发放成本。 - 文档：搜索成功率与双语链接完整率。

text: VideoAgent FAQ Attribute Value --- --- Document version v2.2 Updated 2026-11-05 Q1. How should a video Agent be orchestrated? Answer Use a deterministic workflow: brief, creative diagnosis, treatment, script/beats, storyboard, continuity validation, previz, generation, shot QC, rough cut, and delivery. Human gates protect story direction, budget, and final direction. Models make creative decisions; code owns state, permissions, and cost boundaries. Follow-up: Why not start with multiple autonomous Agents? Answer When responsibilities share one context, a single Agent with explicit tools and state is more reliable. Split into bounded sub-Agents only when writing, visual planning, production, and review have genuinely independent tools, context, and acceptance criteria. Extension: LangGraph Answer Use a StateGraph for stages and conditional edges, checkpoints for recovery, human-in-the-loop for critical approvals, tool allowlists for capability boundaries, and structured output for stable contracts between nodes. Q2. The user says, “Change shot 3 only.” How should the system implement it? Answer Route the request by intent, then apply the change to a stable shot ID. The Agent returns a local shot patch with a version and operation log; other shots and their approval state remain unchanged. Follow-up: Should a review-only request replace the storyboard? Answer No. Review requests enter a read-only branch and return findings and suggestions without producing a write operation. Extension: How can local edits be made concurrency-safe? Answer Use optimistic locking or version-conditioned updates, idempotency keys, and dependency links between a shot revision and any generation job based on it. Q3. What fields define a production-ready shot? Answer Beyond prompt, duration, and aspect ratio, a shot needs scene/beat, story function, shot size, angle, lens, movement, subject action, gaze, blocking, lighting, palette, sound, transition, continuity references, and entry/exit state. Follow-up: Why is a detailed prompt still insufficient? Answer A prompt describes one generation request. Identity, space, gaze, wardrobe, and continuity require structured fields, reference assets, and cross-shot checks. Extension: Which cinematic rules matter? Answer Use master/medium/close/insert/reaction coverage and check the 180-degree rule, 30-degree rule, eyeline match, screen direction, match cuts, and motivated camera movement. Q4. How should LLM output be made truly executable? Answer Define a strict Pydantic schema, validate fields, duration, aspect ratio, shot count, and references, then match the request against provider capabilities such as duration, audio, and input types. Follow-up: What happens after the model returns JSON? Answer JSON is only a candidate result. Schema validation, business validation, permission checks, and cost checks must pass before persistence or generation. Extension: What if validation fails? Answer Allow a bounded structured repair loop. When the repair budget is exhausted, return a stable error and do not enter the billable path or pass malformed text to the next tool. Q5. When should a video Agent use MCP versus a CLI? Answer Choose by runtime boundary. Server-side batch jobs use a CLI; cross-Agent, personal-Agent, and tool-discovery workflows use MCP. Both converge on one Provider contract. Follow-up: Are the integrations redundant? Answer No. The transport adapters differ, while estimate, submit, status, cancel, and normalized errors live in the shared provider boundary. Extension: What should a Provider adapter normalize? Answer Model capabilities, task references, status, error codes, result URLs, credits, and cancellation semantics. Credentials remain inside the adapter and never enter browser or domain objects. Q6. What should happen when a generation request times out? Answer Enter submission uncertain , preserve the idempotency key and request record, then query the provider for reconciliation. If acceptance cannot be proven, stop automatic submission and alert. Follow-up: Can the submission simply be retried three times? Answer Read-only status queries can use bounded backoff. Billable submissions cannot be blindly retried; continue only after proving the request was not accepted or after locating the same task through the idempotency key. Extension: How should duplicate charges be prevented? Answer Use a database-level idempotency key, submission state machine, provider task reference, and an explainable reconciliation path so at-least-once delivery does not become duplicate billing. Q7. How should a video Agent be evaluated? Answer Evaluate by stage. Script: desire, conflict, turn, and ending. Board: coverage, continuity, and feasibility. Shot: identity, prompt alignment, and defects. Cut: rhythm, sound, and retention. Follow-up: Should the storyboard phase show visual quality scores? Answer No. Storyboard readiness is derived from the workflow and Shot completion but is not shown as a progress score. Visual metrics such as character and style consistency belong to Final Cut, where a selected configured evaluator scores extracted frames against an explicit rubric. The product must not fabricate scores when no evaluator is available. Extension: How can judge bias be reduced? Answer Use fixed rubrics, blinded model identity, pairwise comparisons, multi-rater calibration, and continuous monitoring of inter-rater agreement and gaming resistance. Q8. How should character and scene consistency be preserved? Answer Maintain a style bible for characters, costume, locations, props, and visual tone. Each shot references the relevant assets and is checked for eyeline, screen direction, and spatial relationships. Follow-up: Is repeating one description in every prompt sufficient? Answer No. Text alone cannot lock identity and space. Use structured references, first/last frames, or subject references, then run post-generation consistency checks. Extension: Should every shot be regenerated when one drifts? Answer No. Use a continuity graph to identify dependent nodes and regenerate only the affected shots while retaining approved results. Q9. How should credits and user expectations be controlled? Answer Show budgets at the sequence or production-package level, distinguish previews, final shots, and alternate takes, and require a low-cost animatic before expensive generation. Follow-up: Is a confirmation dialog per shot enough? Answer No. Per-shot confirmation prevents individual mistakes but cannot control the whole sequence. Use sequence budgets, quota reservations, and hard stop limits. Extension: What should the cost system record? Answer Estimates, approver, idempotency key, provider cost, actual credits, retry reason, and selected take, forming a reconcilable credit ledger. Q10. How should a sudden drop in generation success be diagnosed? Answer Locate the failed state first: pre-submit, uncertain submit, queued, running, download, or completion. Then segment by provider, model, region, and release time. Follow-up: Should model quality or infrastructure be inspected first? Answer Use observability signals to locate the boundary before assigning blame. Error codes, timeouts, queue depth, and download metrics quickly separate infrastructure, provider, and content-policy failures. Extension: What should observability include? Answer Traces spanning project, shot, job, and provider task; structured logs; SLI/SLOs; latency and success rates; idempotency interception; credit usage; canaries; feature flags; and kill switches. Q11. Why not let one autonomous Agent do everything? Answer Video creation combines creative uncertainty with irreversible cost. Unbounded autonomy makes permissions, budgets, recovery, and audit difficult to prove. Use high autonomy in ideation and strict constraints in production. Follow-up: Does more autonomy always mean more intelligence? Answer Autonomy expands the action space, not the quality of decisions. A production Agent needs boundaries, confirmation gates, and replayable state to turn capability into reliable delivery. Extension: Which actions require human approval? Answer Billable generation, batch regeneration, asset deletion, public publishing, permission changes, and budget changes require allowlisted tools and explicit approval. Q12. What is the most important engineering principle for a video Agent? Answer Represent creative decisions as structured data that can be validated, traced, and edited locally so Agent reasoning can enter a reliable production state machine. Follow-up: Why is this more important than adding more Agents? Answer Without stable data contracts, more Agents only amplify context drift and state inconsistency. Structured data makes delegation, recovery, evaluation, and local regeneration verifiable. Extension: Which base fields matter most? Answer Scene, beat, story function, cinematic grammar, subject action, continuity references, and generation capability requirements connect previz, generation, evaluation, and editing. Q13. What are the main technical trade-offs for a video Agent? Answer The main trade-offs are latency versus quality and cost, autonomy versus control, consistency versus creative flexibility, single versus multiple Agents, and polling versus realtime delivery. Architecture should address the current bottleneck rather than pursue “more intelligent” or “more distributed” labels. Follow-up: When should a single Agent be split into multiple Agents? Answer Split only when subtasks have independent tools, context, evaluation criteria, and scaling needs. Adding Agents does not fix context drift and increases coordination, tracing, and consistency costs. Extension: How should architecture overdesign be avoided? Answer Measure whether the bottleneck is creative quality, provider latency, queue pressure, or database contention, then choose the smallest change. Every added component must justify its operational cost with observable benefit. Q14. How should a video generation system support high concurrency? Answer The API authenticates, validates, and enqueues work without waiting for generation. Workers consume tasks according to provider quotas. Layered limits for users, IPs, tenants, and providers combine with bounded queues, semaphores, idempotency keys, connection pools, and backpressure. Follow-up: What happens when provider concurrency is exhausted? Answer Tasks enter a fair queue prioritized by tenant, priority, and deadline, and the client receives an explainable queued state. Billable submissions must not be retried blindly, and autoscaling cannot exceed provider hard limits. Extension: How should graceful overload work? Answer Use bounded queues, load shedding, circuit breakers, and preview degradation. Protect accepted jobs, reject excess new work explicitly, and expose queue depth, wait time, and rejection rate. Q15. How should a video Agent achieve high availability? Answer Keep the API stateless and multi-instance, make the database the source of truth, and limit Redis to cache, queue, and coordination. Add health checks, rolling releases, timeouts, and circuit breakers; support controlled provider failover behind one adapter. Follow-up: How should the system degrade when the database or Redis fails? Answer On database failure, stop new writes and preserve read-only behavior where possible. On Redis failure, protect the database, pause queue consumption, and recover from persisted jobs. Idempotency keys and reconciliation records must survive to prevent duplicate submissions. Extension: What belongs in high-availability acceptance? Answer Define RTO and RPO, then rehearse instance failure, database failover, queue recovery, provider outage, and regional failure. An architecture is not complete until recovery has been exercised. Q16. How should fallback be designed for the video generation pipeline? Answer Use four fallback layers: explicit model degradation, provider failover, low-cost preview or animatic, and cached read-only output with an error explanation. Every fallback states quality, cost, and capability differences; models are never silently replaced. Follow-up: Can a provider timeout trigger immediate recreation elsewhere? Answer First check the idempotency key and task reference to determine whether the request was accepted. Stop billable retries when the outcome is uncertain and switch providers only after proving non-acceptance and respecting user policy. Extension: How should fallback priority be determined? Answer Prioritize data safety, billing consistency, result availability, quality, and latency in that order. Fallbacks must be observable, explainable, reversible, and constrained by user budget and content policy. Q17. What is the VideoAgent Agent Loop? Answer It is currently a bounded planning run, not an unrestricted ReAct loop. FastAPI accepts the user message, stores a run id , assembles bounded Context, loads Memory and current project resources, resolves an optional Skill, and executes the single LangGraph plan storyboard node. The planner returns a StoryboardPlan ; Pydantic validates it before workflow, Message, Character, and Shot state are persisted. The director reply is then stored and returned. Follow-up: Why does the waiting UI show many steps? Answer Each step is persisted in agent activities , and the client polls by run id to display real context → memory → skill → planning → validation → state → reply events. It does not simulate tool execution; a Skill or MCP call that did not occur is never shown as completed. Extension: When is a true multi-turn Loop needed? Answer A multi-node loop is needed when the Agent must choose its next action from tool results, such as reading assets, invoking visual review, retrying from a typed failure, or asking for missing input. That loop requires budgets, stopping conditions, approval gates, and recoverable checkpoints. Q18. How are VideoAgent Context and Memory designed and managed? Answer Context is the bounded input for one planning call: project title, brief, current request, locale, workflow stage/status, current Character/Shot summaries, recent conversation, and optional Skill instructions. Short-term Memory reads the eight most recent historical messages, clips each to 600 characters, excludes the current request, and caps Storyboard context at 20 Shots. Follow-up: Where does long-term Memory live? Answer The relational database is the source of truth. It stores Project, Conversation, Message, ProjectWorkflow, Storyboard, Character, Shot, Asset, and GenerationJob state. Vector memory, cross-project user memory, and automatic long-term summaries are not enabled. Extension: What is required before adding vector Memory? Answer Add user/project isolation, deduplication, TTL, deletion propagation, permission checks, and inspectable retrieval. Retrieved text is still a bounded Context input; it never replaces authoritative database state or approval records. Q19. How are VideoAgent Skills, MCP, and SubAgents invoked? Answer A Skill is not currently a tool execution. The composer writes its ID into project Production settings . The Context Builder looks up a Skill published by the current user and attaches persisted instructions and the starter prompt to Planner Context. A built-in Skill without database instructions contributes only its ID as a directing constraint. Follow-up: Does the Storyboard Agent call MCP directly? Answer No. MCP is behind the billable provider boundary. After explicit generation approval, the Generation API resolves a provider. With the Kling MCP backend, the Provider Resolver creates a StreamableHTTPToolClient with the current user's OAuth token, then KlingVideoProvider invokes text to video , image to video , or query tasks . The default China-region path uses a controlled CLI subprocess. This prevents the planning Agent from creating unreviewed billable side effects. Extension: Are there SubAgents today? Answer No. There is currently one LangGraph plan storyboard node and no SubAgent runtime, delegation protocol, or parallel subgraph. Split responsibilities only when writing, visual, review, or production work has independent tools, context, acceptance criteria, and scaling needs. Every SubAgent would still share the traceable run id , budget, and approval boundary. Q20. How are VideoAgent Hooks used? Answer A Hook is a directing constraint for the opening seconds that establishes attention. It is not a webhook or runtime event. The composer offers Auto, visual impact, narrative twist, spoken hook, sound cue, and proof-first openings. VideoAgent writes the selected Hook into the project brief and uses it while planning the creative direction, first narrative beat, and opening shot. Auto lets the Agent choose according to subject, audience, and platform. To use a Hook, select one in the composer or apply a Playbook with a default Hook, describe the subject and desired response, approve the direction, then ask for a targeted change such as “make the opening more proof-led” if the first beat does not match. Hook selection remains visible in Settings and can be changed before any billable generation. Follow-up: How is a Hook different from a Playbook? Answer A Playbook is a complete reusable starting strategy containing a prompt, Skill, Hook, style, frame, duration, model, and review mode. A Hook defines only how the opening earns attention. One Playbook can use different Hooks, and one Hook can appear in multiple Playbooks. Extension: Does a Hook guarantee performance? Answer No. It constrains intent, while results still depend on writing, shots, performance, editing, and audience. Use batch variants to compare several openings against completion and engagement data rather than treating a Hook as a performance guarantee. Q21. How does VideoAgent choose a model when a Skill has multiple Provider implementations? Answer The Agent first filters candidates by task and capability: text, image, or video; text/image/video references; duration; aspect ratio; audio and language; output quality; provider availability; and estimated credits. It prefers the project default only when that model satisfies every requirement. If two providers can complete the same Skill, the Agent shows the viable choices with a recommended default, provider/model name, key capability differences, and cost instead of silently routing to one. Follow-up: Can the user change the model after the project has started? Answer Yes. Character and Scene generation exposes an image-model selector, and Shot generation exposes a video-model selector for both text-to-video and image-to-video. “Project default” inherits the initial choice; an explicit override applies to the next generation and invalidates the previous estimate. Provider switching never happens silently after a paid task has been accepted. Extension: Can the user change the text-planning model too? Answer Planning-model choice belongs to the same task-routing rule, but the current deployment exposes the planner configured by the administrator. If multiple planning models are configured, the selector should live in Settings and show their reasoning, context, latency, and price trade-offs. Generated content from one model is never described as if another model produced it.

text: VideoAgent 客服 FAQ 属性 内容 --- --- 文档版本 v2.4 更新日期 2026-11-05 Q1. VideoAgent 的主编排应怎样设计？ 答案 VideoAgent 采用确定性工作流：Brief（创作需求简报）、创作诊断、 Treatment（创作阐述）、Script/Beats（剧本与叙事节拍）、 Storyboard（故事板）、连续性校验、预演、生成、镜头 QC（质量检查）、粗剪和交付。故事方向、预算和 成片方向设置人工确认点，模型负责创意，代码负责状态、权限和成本边界。 追问： 为什么不直接使用多个自由 Agent？ 答案 职责共享同一上下文时，单 Agent 配明确工具和状态更稳定。只有剧本、视觉、 制片和审片具有真正独立的工具、上下文和验收标准时，才拆成受限子 Agent， 由父流程协调。 扩展： LangGraph（图式工作流编排框架） 答案 使用 StateGraph（状态图）表达阶段和条件边，checkpoint（可恢复的流程快照） 保存状态，human-in-the-loop（人工介入确认）负责关键确认， tool allowlist（工具白名单）限制能力边界，结构化输出 保证节点间契约稳定。 Q2. 用户说“只改第三镜，其他不要动”，系统应如何实现？ 答案 先识别意图，再把修改落到稳定的 shot id（镜头唯一标识）上。 Agent 输出局部 shot patch（单镜头局部修改补丁）， 记录版本和操作日志，其他镜头及其审批状态保持不变。 追问： 如果用户只是问“这个分镜怎么样”，也应该重写故事板吗？ 答案 不应该。只评估请求进入 review（评估）分支，返回问题和建议，不产生写操作。 扩展： 局部修改如何保证并发安全？ 答案 使用乐观锁（更新时检查版本是否仍一致）或版本条件更新；同一请求携带 幂等键（同一请求重复提交也只执行一次）；镜头修改与后续生成任务通过 依赖关系关联，避免旧版本结果覆盖新镜头。 Q3. 一个可生成的专业镜头，至少需要哪些字段？ 答案 除 Prompt、时长和画幅外，还需要 scene/beat（场景与叙事节拍）、叙事功能、景别、机位、镜头、 运镜、主体动作、视线、走位、光线、色彩、声音、转场、连续性引用和前后景状态。 追问： 为什么 Prompt 写得足够长仍然不够？ 答案 Prompt 是单次生成描述，不承担结构化约束。人物、空间、视线和服装的一致性需要 独立字段、引用资产和跨镜头校验。 扩展： 需要哪些电影语法？ 答案 使用 master/medium/close/insert/reaction（全景/中景/近景/插入/反应镜头） 组织覆盖，检查 180 度规则、30 度规则、eyeline match（视线匹配）、 screen direction（屏幕方向）、match cut（匹配剪辑）和有动机的运镜。 Q4. 如何让 LLM 输出真正可执行？ 答案 用 Pydantic（Python 数据校验库）定义严格输出结构，校验字段、时长、比例、 镜头数量和引用关系。执行前再做 Provider（模型服务商）能力匹配，确认模型支持目标时长、音频和输入类型。 追问： 模型返回 JSON（结构化数据格式）后还需要做什么？ 答案 JSON 只是候选结果。系统要继续做 Schema（字段结构定义）校验、业务校验、权限检查和费用检查， 全部通过后才进入写库或生成阶段。 扩展： 校验失败怎么处理？ 答案 允许有限次结构化修复；修复预算耗尽后返回稳定错误码，不进入计费链路，也不把 异常文本直接交给下一个工具。 Q5. MCP（模型上下文协议）和 CLI（命令行接口）应该怎么选？ 答案 按运行边界选择。服务端批处理和稳定部署使用 CLI；跨 Agent、个人 Agent 和 工具发现场景使用 MCP。两种协议都收敛到统一 Provider（模型服务商）契约。 追问： 两者同时存在会不会重复建设？ 答案 不会。重复的是底层能力，不重复的应是接口。传输层分别适配 CLI 和 MCP， 业务层只依赖 estimate（估算）、submit（提交）、status（查询）、 cancel（取消）和统一错误模型。 扩展： Provider 适配器要标准化什么？ 答案 标准化模型能力、任务引用、状态、错误码、结果 URL、积分和取消语义；凭据只在 适配器内部使用，不进入浏览器或领域对象。 Q6. 生成任务超时后怎么办？ 答案 计费提交超时先进入 submission uncertain （提交结果不确定）状态，保留 幂等键（同一请求重复提交也只执行一次）和请求记录，再查询 Provider（模型服务商）对账。无法确认是否受理时停止自动重试并告警。 追问： 可以自动重试三次吗？ 答案 普通只读查询可以退避重试；计费提交不能盲目重试。只有确认未受理或通过幂等键 找到同一任务后，才能继续。 扩展： 怎样防止重复扣费？ 答案 数据库唯一幂等键、提交状态机（状态及合法迁移规则）、 Provider Task Reference（服务商任务编号）和人工可解释的对账流程 共同保证 at-least-once（至少一次投递）不会变成重复计费。 Q7. VideoAgent 的评测应该怎么做？ 答案 按阶段评测。剧本看欲望、冲突、转折和结尾；故事板看覆盖、连续性和可生成性； 镜头看人物、Prompt 匹配和技术瑕疵；成片看节奏、声音和观看留存。 追问： 故事板阶段需要视觉质量分数吗？ 答案 不需要。故事板阶段不显示制作进度条；人物一致性、风格一致性等视觉指标应面向 Final Cut，由用户选择已配置的视觉评估模型， 基于成片帧和明确 rubric 计算；评估器不可用时不得生成伪造分数。 扩展： 怎样降低 Judge 偏差？ 答案 固定 rubric、盲化模型来源、pairwise 比较、多人标注校准，并持续监控 inter-rater agreement 和 gaming resistance。 Q8. 如何保证多镜头的人物与场景一致性？ 答案 建立 Style Bible（视觉风格手册），分别管理角色、服装、场景、道具和视觉基调；每个镜头引用 对应资产，生成前检查视线、屏幕方向和空间关系。 追问： 只把同一段描述放进每个 Prompt 够吗？ 答案 不够。文本描述无法稳定锁定身份和空间，必须使用结构化引用、首尾帧或 subject reference，并在生成后做一致性检查。 扩展： 发现不一致时重做全部镜头吗？ 答案 只重做受影响的镜头。通过 continuity graph（连续性依赖图）找到依赖节点， 保留已通过的镜头。 Q9. 如何控制积分成本和用户预期？ 答案 按序列或制作包展示预算，区分预览、正式镜头和备选 take（镜头候选版本）。 高成本生成前先完成低成本 Animatic（动态分镜预演），重做时说明原因和预计费用。 追问： 每个镜头都弹确认框是不是就够了？ 答案 不够。逐镜确认只能防单次误操作，不能控制整段视频预算。需要序列预算、 额度预留和超预算停止机制。 扩展： 成本系统要记录什么？ 答案 记录估算、批准人、幂等键（同一请求重复提交也只执行一次）、 Provider（模型服务商）成本、实际积分、重试原因和最终 take（镜头候选版本）， 形成可核对的 credit ledger（积分流水）。 Q10. 如果线上生成成功率突然下降，如何定位问题？ 答案 先按状态机定位失败发生在提交前、提交不确定、排队、运行、下载还是完成阶段， 再按 Provider（模型服务商）、模型、地区和发布时间切分。 追问： 应最先看模型质量还是基础设施？ 答案 先看可观测信号判断故障边界，不先归因模型。错误码、超时、队列和下载指标能 快速区分基础设施、Provider 与内容策略问题。 扩展： 怎样设计观测体系？ 答案 用 trace（调用链追踪）串起 project（项目）、shot（镜头）、job（任务）和 provider task（服务商任务），记录结构化日志、SLI/SLO（服务质量指标与目标）、 延迟、成功率、幂等拦截和积分消耗，并配置 canary（灰度发布）、 feature flag（功能开关）和 kill switch（紧急停用开关）。 Q11. 为什么不用一个无限自主的 Agent 完成所有事情？ 答案 视频创作同时包含创意不确定性和不可逆成本。无限自主会让权限、预算、状态恢复 和审计难以证明，应采用“高自主创意、强约束生产”。 追问： 自主性越高不是越智能吗？ 答案 自主性提高的是可行动空间，不等于决策质量。生产 Agent 需要边界、确认门和 可回放状态，才能把能力转化为稳定交付。 扩展： 哪些动作必须人工确认？ 答案 计费生成、批量重做、删除资产、公开发布、修改权限和改变预算必须走白名单工具 与人工确认。 Q12. VideoAgent 最关键的工程原则是什么？ 答案 把创意决策表示为可校验、可追踪、可局部修改的结构化数据，让 Agent 的推理结果 能够进入可靠的生产状态机。 追问： 为什么这个原则比增加更多 Agent 更重要？ 答案 没有稳定数据契约，更多 Agent 只会放大上下文漂移和状态不一致。结构化数据让 分工、恢复、评估和局部重做成为可验证行为。 扩展： 最重要的基础字段是什么？ 答案 scene、beat、story function、镜头语言、主体动作、连续性引用和生成能力要求。 这些字段共同连接预演、生成、评估与剪辑。 Q13. VideoAgent 的主要技术权衡是什么？ 答案 核心权衡包括延迟、质量和成本，自主性与可控性，一致性与创作灵活性， 单 Agent 与多 Agent，轮询与实时推送。架构选择应服务于当前瓶颈，而不是追求 概念上的“更智能”或“更分布式”。 追问： 什么时候应从单 Agent 拆成多 Agent？ 答案 当子任务具有独立工具、上下文、评估标准和扩缩容需求时再拆分。仅靠增加 Agent 无法解决上下文漂移，反而会增加协调、追踪和一致性成本。 扩展： 如何避免架构过度设计？ 答案 先量化瓶颈来自创意质量、Provider（模型服务商）延迟、队列积压还是数据库竞争，再选择最小 改动。每次扩展都要求可观测指标证明收益大于运维复杂度。 Q14. 视频生成系统如何支撑高并发？ 答案 API（应用程序接口）只负责鉴权、校验和入队，不在请求线程中等待生成； Worker（后台任务进程）按 Provider（模型服务商）配额消费任务。通过用户、 IP（网络地址）、租户和 Provider 分层限流，配合有界队列（容量限定的任务队列）、并发信号量（限制同时运行任务数）、 幂等键（同一请求重复提交也只执行一次）、连接池和背压（下游过载时向上游减速）控制吞吐。 追问： Provider 并发额度耗尽时怎么办？ 答案 任务进入公平队列，按租户、优先级和截止时间调度；向客户端返回可解释的排队 状态。计费提交禁止因限流盲目重试，扩缩容也不能突破 Provider 的硬配额。 扩展： 如何实现优雅过载？ 答案 使用有界队列、load shedding（主动丢弃超载请求）、circuit breaker（熔断） 和降级预览；优先保护已受理任务， 明确拒绝超出容量的新请求，并暴露队列深度、等待时间和拒绝率。 Q15. VideoAgent 如何设计高可用？ 答案 API（应用程序接口）保持无状态并多实例部署，数据库保存业务事实， Redis（内存数据结构存储）只承担缓存、队列和 协调。服务提供健康检查、滚动发布、超时和熔断；Provider 通过统一适配器支持 受控切换。 追问： 数据库或 Redis 故障时如何降级？ 答案 数据库故障时停止新增写操作，优先维持只读；Redis 故障时保护数据库，暂停队列 消费并从持久化任务恢复。幂等键和对账记录必须保留，避免恢复后重复提交。 扩展： 高可用验收应包含什么？ 答案 先定义 RTO/RPO（恢复时间目标/恢复点目标），再演练实例故障、数据库切换、队列恢复、Provider（模型服务商）故障和区域 故障；没有恢复演练的高可用架构不能视为完成。 Q16. 视频生成链路应怎样设计兜底策略？ 答案 兜底分四层：显式模型降级、Provider（模型服务商）切换、 低成本预览或 Animatic（动态分镜预演）、只读缓存与 错误说明。任何降级都要说明质量、价格和能力差异，不能静默替换模型或产生额外 费用。 追问： Provider 超时后能否直接切换另一家重做？ 答案 先通过幂等键和任务引用确认是否已受理。无法确认时停止计费重试；确认未受理且 用户策略允许后，才可切换到备用 Provider。 扩展： 兜底策略的优先级如何确定？ 答案 依次考虑数据安全、费用一致性、结果可用性、质量和延迟。降级必须可观测、可 解释、可撤销，并受用户预算和内容策略约束。 Q17. VideoAgent 的 Agent Loop 是什么？ 答案 当前是受控的单次规划 Run，不是无限自主的 ReAct 循环。FastAPI 接收用户消息后， 依次保存 run id 、构建有界 Context、读取 Memory 和当前项目资源、解析可选 Skill， 再执行 LangGraph 的单个 plan storyboard 节点。Planner 输出 StoryboardPlan ，经 Pydantic 校验后写入工作流、Message、Character 和 Shot 状态， 最后生成导演回复。 追问： 为什么还能在等待界面看到很多步骤？ 答案 每一步都会写入 agent activities ，前端按 run id 轮询并显示 context → memory → skill → planning → validation → state → reply 的真实事件。 它不是用假动画模拟工具执行；没有发生的 MCP 或 Skill 调用不会显示为已完成。 扩展： 什么时候才需要真正的多轮 Loop？ 答案 当 Agent 需要根据工具结果决定下一步，例如自动读取素材、调用视觉评估、根据失败原因 重试或请求用户补充信息时，才需要把单节点图扩展为有预算、有终止条件、有审批门和 可恢复 Checkpoint 的多节点循环。 Q18. VideoAgent 的 Context 和 Memory 怎么设计和管理？ 答案 Context 是单次规划调用的有界输入，包含项目标题、Brief、当前请求、Locale、 工作流阶段/状态、当前 Character/Shot 摘要、最近对话和可选 Skill 指令。短期 Memory 只读取最近 8 条历史消息，每条截断到 600 字符，并排除当前请求；故事板上下文最多 读取 20 个 Shot。 追问： 长期 Memory 存在哪里？ 答案 关系数据库是唯一事实来源，保存 Project、Conversation、Message、 ProjectWorkflow、Storyboard、Character、Shot、Asset 和 GenerationJob。当前没有 向量数据库、跨项目用户记忆或自动长期摘要。 扩展： 以后增加向量 Memory 要注意什么？ 答案 必须有用户和项目级隔离、写入去重、TTL、删除传播、权限校验和可解释召回；召回内容 只能作为有界 Context 的一部分，不能取代数据库状态或审批记录。 Q19. VideoAgent 的 Skill、MCP、SubAgent 是怎么调用的？ 答案 Skill 当前不是工具执行。Composer 把 Skill ID 写入项目 Production settings ； Context Builder 会在当前用户已发布的 Skill 中查找它，并把持久化的 instructions 和 starter prompt 加入 Planner Context。内置 Skill 没有数据库指令时，只传入 Skill ID 作为创作约束。 追问： Storyboard Agent 会直接调用 MCP 吗？ 答案 不会。MCP 位于付费生成 Provider 边界之后。用户明确批准生成后，Generation API 才解析 Provider；当 Kling 使用 MCP Backend 时，Provider Resolver 使用当前用户的 OAuth Token 创建 StreamableHTTPToolClient ，再由 KlingVideoProvider 调用 text to video 、 image to video 或 query tasks 。默认国内版路径使用受控 CLI 子进程。这样可以阻止规划 Agent 自行产生计费副作用。 扩展： 现在有 SubAgent 吗？ 答案 没有。当前只有 LangGraph 的单个 plan storyboard 节点，没有独立 SubAgent 运行时、委派协议或并行子图。只有在剧本、视觉、评估或制片任务具备独立工具、 上下文、验收标准和扩缩容需求时才应拆分；拆分后每个 SubAgent 仍需共享可追踪 run id 、预算和审批边界。 Q20. VideoAgent 的 Hook 是怎么用的？ 答案 Hook 是成片开头用于抓住注意力的创作约束，不是 Webhook 或运行时事件。用户在创作框 选择自动、视觉冲击、叙事反转、口播开场、声音开场或效果实证后，VideoAgent 会把这个 选择写入项目 Brief，并在整体设定、首个叙事节拍和开场镜头规划中使用它。选择“自动” 时，由 Agent 根据题材、受众和发布平台决定开场方式。 实际使用时，可以选择一个 Hook，或应用一个带默认 Hook 的策略；描述主题与希望激发的 反应后批准整体方向。如果首个节拍不符合预期，可以直接说“开场改成效果实证”等具体修改， Hook 会保留在 Settings 中，并可在产生计费生成前继续调整。 追问： Hook 和策略有什么区别？ 答案 策略是一套完整创作起点，包含提示词、Skill、Hook、风格、画幅、时长、模型和审核方式； Hook 只描述开头如何建立注意力。一个策略可以选择不同的 Hook，同一个 Hook 也可以用于 多个策略。 扩展： Hook 是否能保证视频效果？ 答案 不能。Hook 只约束开场意图，实际效果仍取决于脚本、镜头、表演、剪辑和平台受众。建议 用批量变体生成多个开场版本并比较完播与互动数据，不应把 Hook 选择当作效果保证。 Q21. VideoAgent 如何在同一个 Skill 有多个 Provider 时选择模型？ 答案 Agent 先按任务与能力筛选候选：文生文、文生图、图生图、文生视频或图生视频；图片、 视频、主体、关键帧和音频引用；时长、画幅、语言、声音、输出质量、Provider 可用性与 预计积分。只有项目默认模型满足全部要求时才直接使用；如果两个 Provider 都能完成同一 Skill，界面会展示可执行选项、推荐默认项、 服务商/模型 、关键能力差异与成本，不会静默 选择其中一方。 追问： 项目开始后还能更换模型吗？ 答案 可以。Character 与 Scene 提供图片模型选择，Shot 提供视频模型选择，文生视频和图生视频 都使用当前选择。“Project default”继承初始设置；显式切换只影响下一次生成，并使旧积分 估算失效。计费任务一旦被 Provider 接受，不会在用户不知情时切换 Provider。 扩展： 文生文规划模型也能切换吗？ 答案 规划模型也遵循相同的任务路由原则，但当前部署只开放管理员配置的 Planner。若以后配置 多个规划模型，应在 Settings 中展示推理能力、Context、延迟和价格差异。一个模型生成的 内容不能描述成另一个模型的产出。
